39a8edfe-6da8-48e4-ba2d-6698f79ea1a9/Eve.en: On this day, heavy clouds shroud the mountains. While <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> journeys on,<NL>a peal of thunder bursts from the clouds, followed at once by pouring rain!<NL>Gales whistle and rain hangs thick. The road ahead grows indistinct, and the wet rocks render passage difficult...
39a8edfe-6da8-48e4-ba2d-6698f79ea1a9/Eve.cn: 这一日，山冥云重，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>行路途中，<NL>忽听得云中一声霹雳，便见瓢泼大雨，顷刻落下！<NL>一时风啸啸，雨蒙蒙，眼前去路朦胧难辨，山石湿滑更难前行……
39a8edfe-6da8-48e4-ba2d-6698f79ea1a9/Eve.ru: В этот день горы окутаны тяжелыми тучами. В то время как <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> путешествия по,<NL>из облаков вырывается раскат грома, за которым сразу же следует проливной дождь!<NL>Свистят порывы ветра, и навис густой дождь. Дорога впереди становится неразличимой, а мокрые камни затрудняют проезд...

27c2e195-4509-40d3-a67a-f62a3cb05fac/Eve.en: With the storm in full fury, wind and rain surge as if to engulf the wilds.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> clenches <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> teeth and forces onward through the gale and rain, weaving through trees and brush in repeated searches.<NL>Only when completely drenched does <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> finally finds a ruined temple, abandoned for ages.<NL>Though crumbling, it is enough to keep out the wind and rain...
27c2e195-4509-40d3-a67a-f62a3cb05fac/Eve.cn: 此刻风雨磅礴，势吞山野，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>咬紧牙关，汤风冒雪，过树穿草，于四下几番搜寻，<NL>终于在浑身尽湿之际，寻得一间早已荒废的破庙。<NL>此庙虽显颓败，然则遮风避雨，却是足矣……

972858c2-886b-4205-a0a3-65a82ff9109d/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> has urgent matters to attend to and cannot afford delay, and thus presses on through the rain, continuing the journey...
972858c2-886b-4205-a0a3-65a82ff9109d/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>此刻要事在身，不可耽搁，只得冒雨前行，继续赶路……
972858c2-886b-4205-a0a3-65a82ff9109d/Eve.ru: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> у него есть неотложные дела, которыми он должен заняться, и он не может позволить себе задержку, а потому спешит сквозь дождь, продолжая путешествие...

4b2c718e-bce0-458d-b06d-08f96b59a6da/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> enters the temple without delay.<NL>The biting wind recedes, and the rain is kept beyond the eaves.<NL>After steadying <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> breath, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> channels inner Qi to drive away the cold and damp clinging to <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> body.<NL>Once warmth slowly returns, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> surveys the humble shrine more carefully:<NL><NL>The altar in the main hall leans askew, standing empty—evidently abandoned for many years.<NL>Small doors flank the altar on both sides, each leading to a narrow passage.<NL>Following these passages allows one to venture deeper into the temple, toward the rear courtyard and monks' quarters.
4b2c718e-bce0-458d-b06d-08f96b59a6da/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>立时迈入庙中，<NL>寒风渐远，雨幕亦阻于屋外。<NL>如此缓过一口气，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>当即运转内力，驱散周身湿寒，<NL>待得渐渐回暖，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>方才细瞧此间小庙：<NL><NL>只见正堂佛坛歪斜，坛上空空如也，想必早已无人供奉，<NL>佛坛两侧则各开一扇小门，门后一条小廊，<NL>穿行而过，便可深入庙中，去往后院禅房。

4b2c718e-bce0-458d-b06d-08f96b59a6da/Opt.en: (I wonder if this place can offer me a moment of peaceful rest...)
4b2c718e-bce0-458d-b06d-08f96b59a6da/Opt.cn: （不知此地可否供我安心歇息……）
4b2c718e-bce0-458d-b06d-08f96b59a6da/Opt.ru: (Интересно, сможет ли это место предложить мне минутку спокойного отдыха...)

60c6c3d6-2ca7-46f8-ab69-5437d818f25c/Eve.en: Before settling in to rest, wary that demons or monsters might be hiding here,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> has no choice but to venture deeper into the temple to investigate.<NL>After passing through the narrow corridor and reaching the courtyard, a sound of sorrowful sighing drifts from the meditation chambers, lingering with troubling persistence.<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> follows the sound and glimpses a faint human silhouette within an inner room,<NL>as if someone else is also taking shelter here from the rain...
60c6c3d6-2ca7-46f8-ab69-5437d818f25c/Eve.cn: 安歇之前，为防有妖魔藏身于此，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>只得深入庙中，前去查探。<NL>待得穿过小廊，行至院中之时，便听得禅房之中传来哀叹之声，疑虑重重，久久未绝。<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>循声望去，便见内室隐隐有一人影，<NL>似是也在此地避雨歇息……

190e078b-467d-43ad-bc20-82c1853653be/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> steps slowly into the chamber of chan.<NL>The room is dilapidated on all sides, and a young monk sits cross-legged on the floor.<NL>His brows are tightly knit, prayer beads clasped in his hand, motionless.<NL>Hearing <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> approach, he comes back to himself and immediately presses his palms together in greeting toward <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>:<NL>"Amitabha... The rain has been unceasing, and the chill grows ever deeper. Might you also have come here to shelter from the storm?"
190e078b-467d-43ad-bc20-82c1853653be/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>缓步迈入此间禅房，<NL>见房内四面破陋，一名年轻僧人席地而坐。<NL>那僧人此时眉头紧皱，手捏念珠，一动不动，<NL>听得<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>动静，便即回过神来，向<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>合掌一拜：<NL>“阿弥陀佛……阴雨连绵，寒意渐深，施主可是也来此地暂避风雨？”

190e078b-467d-43ad-bc20-82c1853653be/Opt.en: The storm shows no sign of letting up, and the road ahead is hard to travel. It seems you are in the same plight, master...
190e078b-467d-43ad-bc20-82c1853653be/Opt.cn: 风雨未停，前路难行。看来这位师父亦是如此……
190e078b-467d-43ad-bc20-82c1853653be/Opt.ru: Шторм, похоже, не собирается утихать, и дорога впереди труднопроходима. Похоже, вы находитесь в таком же тяжелом положении, мастер...

805ad618-3669-40c3-a195-9321e1aff276/Eve.en: The monk replies calmly:<NL>"You overpraise me. I am yet a novice in cultivation,<NL>and cannot bear the title of 'master.' Please call me by my dharma name, 'Wuzi.'<NL>I was originally traveling to the Shaolin Temple of Mt. Song, wishing to be accepted there for focused training, to practice Mind Cultivation.<NL>By chance, this torrential rain barred the way, and thus I stopped here to avoid it..."
805ad618-3669-40c3-a195-9321e1aff276/Eve.cn: 僧人不紧不慢道：<NL>“施主谬赞，小僧尚在修行，<NL>担不得‘师父’二字，施主只唤小僧法号‘无字’便是。<NL>小僧此行本是要往嵩山少林寺去，盼能拜入门中潜心进修，锤炼心性，<NL>偏逢这大雨阻路，才在此处暂避……”

805ad618-3669-40c3-a195-9321e1aff276/Opt.en: I see... When I heard your sighs just now, was it the rain that troubled you?
805ad618-3669-40c3-a195-9321e1aff276/Opt.cn: 原来如此……方才我听闻你唉声叹气，莫非便是为这大雨？
805ad618-3669-40c3-a195-9321e1aff276/Opt.ru: Я понимаю... Когда я только что услышал твои вздохи, тебя беспокоил дождь?

48e58830-2412-4347-9553-4cef71e33450/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> suddenly remembers that it was Wuzi who had been sighing softly in the chamber, and thus speaks to ask why:<NL>The Buddhist path values freedom from worldly hindrance. As a monk, if Wuzi harbors obstacles in his heart,<NL>how can he focus on Buddhist study and make progress in cultivation?
48e58830-2412-4347-9553-4cef71e33450/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>忽而忆起，<NL>方才正是无字，在这禅房中暗自叹息，不禁出言问及缘由：<NL>佛家修行，向来讲究心无挂碍，无字既是出家僧人，若是心里存了妨害，<NL>如何能专心研修佛学，精进修行？

48e58830-2412-4347-9553-4cef71e33450/Opt.en: had thought that a monk's heart should be void of all things, pure and tranquil like still water...
48e58830-2412-4347-9553-4cef71e33450/Opt.cn: 我原以为，出家人心中空空，当如止水般澄澈……
48e58830-2412-4347-9553-4cef71e33450/Opt.ru: Я думал, что сердце Монаха должно быть пустым от всего, чистым и безмятежным, как стоячая вода...

18399ae0-f28e-4c1a-905d-80993f304cb0/Eve.en: Wuzi is taken aback by these words, rises, and bows once more, then says:<NL>"Just so... I didn't expect that you would possess such insight into the human heart.<NL>In but a few words, you have already laid bare where my cultivation still falls short."<NL><NL>With that, Wuzi begins to recount his troubles in detail...
18399ae0-f28e-4c1a-905d-80993f304cb0/Eve.cn: 无字闻言一愣，起身再拜，又道：<NL>“正是此理……未曾料及，施主竟有这般洞悉人心的本事，<NL>三言两语，便已道破小僧修行未够之处。”<NL><NL>随即，无字便将自己的烦恼娓娓道来……

fadfffe0-e35b-4e35-aa7d-e3dfcd7dd2f9/Eve.en: "Though the storm rages beyond the temple, my mind remained unmoved.<NL>I wished to meditate here a moment ago, but perhaps from concern for the world's suffering and the menace of evil,<NL>countless inner demons and illusions appeared before my mind's eye, denying me peace...<NL>Troubled by these inner demons, I sighed aloud—and it so happened that you overheard."<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> listens to Wuzi and responds...
fadfffe0-e35b-4e35-aa7d-e3dfcd7dd2f9/Eve.cn: “庙外飘风暴雨，却未曾扰乱我心。<NL>适才，小僧本欲在此处打坐静思，然而许是因为忧思天下之苦，妖魔之患，<NL>竟在心中照见诸多心魔幻影，不得清净……<NL>小僧为这心魔烦恼不已，便叹息出声，倒是恰好叫施主听着了。”<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>听罢无字此言，只道……

fadfffe0-e35b-4e35-aa7d-e3dfcd7dd2f9/Opt.en: If deluded thoughts arise, they give birth to all manner of karma. You are a cultivator. How could you not understand such a principle?
fadfffe0-e35b-4e35-aa7d-e3dfcd7dd2f9/Opt.cn: 若生妄心，便造种种业。你乃修行之人，竟不知晓这般道理？
fadfffe0-e35b-4e35-aa7d-e3dfcd7dd2f9/Opt.ru: Если возникают заблуждающиеся мысли, они порождают всевозможную карму. Вы - самосовершенствующийся. Как вы могли не понять такого принципа?

fadfffe0-e35b-4e35-aa7d-e3dfcd7dd2f9/Opt.en: It is precisely because your heart holds goodwill, yet clings too tightly, that inner demons arise and illusions appear...
fadfffe0-e35b-4e35-aa7d-e3dfcd7dd2f9/Opt.cn: 因你心存善念，执迷太过，方才生出心魔，见幻影妄相……
fadfffe0-e35b-4e35-aa7d-e3dfcd7dd2f9/Opt.ru: Именно из-за того, что в вашем сердце есть добрая воля, но оно слишком крепко держится, возникают внутренние демоны и появляются иллюзии...

fadfffe0-e35b-4e35-aa7d-e3dfcd7dd2f9/Opt.en: When the mind returns to stillness, there is neither form nor color. Nothing to see, nothing to hear...
fadfffe0-e35b-4e35-aa7d-e3dfcd7dd2f9/Opt.cn: 心神向寂，无色无形。睹之不见，听之无声……
fadfffe0-e35b-4e35-aa7d-e3dfcd7dd2f9/Opt.ru: Когда ум возвращается к спокойствию, не остается ни формы, ни цвета. Ничего не видно, ничего не слышно...

fadfffe0-e35b-4e35-aa7d-e3dfcd7dd2f9/Opt.en: Rather than sitting here fretting in vain, you'd be better off pulling a blanket over your head and getting some sleep!
fadfffe0-e35b-4e35-aa7d-e3dfcd7dd2f9/Opt.cn: 你这和尚，与其坐在此地瞎琢磨，倒不如蒙头睡去更实在些！
fadfffe0-e35b-4e35-aa7d-e3dfcd7dd2f9/Opt.ru: Вместо того чтобы сидеть здесь и волноваться понапрасну, тебе лучше было бы натянуть одеяло на голову и немного поспать!

fadfffe0-e35b-4e35-aa7d-e3dfcd7dd2f9/Opt.en: If inner demons bar your way, cut them down. Once the demons are gone, troubles vanish of themselves!
fadfffe0-e35b-4e35-aa7d-e3dfcd7dd2f9/Opt.cn: 心魔阻你，斩了便是；心魔既空，烦恼自无！
fadfffe0-e35b-4e35-aa7d-e3dfcd7dd2f9/Opt.ru: Если внутренние демоны преграждают вам путь, уничтожьте их. Как только демоны уходят, неприятности исчезают сами собой!

cdb651d8-589f-4a20-893f-af80ab09db3e/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s remark brings Wuzi sudden clarity, and a look of surprise crosses his features.<NL>After a brief pause, Wuzi sighs gently and says with some regret:<NL>"All appearances are delusional... I was fixated on a single notion and thus lost myself in confusion...<NL>Maybe... this downpour that held me here, letting me encounter the benefactor and gain this counsel, was ordained by heaven."
cdb651d8-589f-4a20-893f-af80ab09db3e/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>如此一言，<NL>竟令无字醍醐灌顶，显出几分愕然之色。<NL>须臾，只听得无字轻轻一叹，怅然道：<NL>“凡所有相，皆是虚妄……小僧先前竟执于一端，反陷迷障之中……<NL>或许……这瓢泼大雨困我在此，令小僧得遇施主、受此点拨，亦是天意使然。”

3731b356-b0e0-4f9b-9fc4-b1bdb1ceff30/Eve.en: Wuzi offers a gentle smile and bows his head:<NL>"With just a single phrase, you struck directly at the heart of the matter.<NL>A moment's contemplation was enough for me to absorb it fully—your hidden meaning, I now understand in full.<NL>When one is lost, the heart is heavy. When one awakens, the heart is empty again.<NL>Delusive thoughts stir, and thus inner demons arise, leaving the heart increasingly clouded..."
3731b356-b0e0-4f9b-9fc4-b1bdb1ceff30/Eve.cn: 无字微微一笑，颔首道：<NL>“施主轻轻一语，却是一语中的，<NL>小僧稍加琢磨，将之融会贯通，施主言中深意，小僧自也就全然知晓了。<NL>昔日迷时为有心，尔时悟罢了无心。<NL>心起妄念，心魔便由此生，自然搅得内心愈发不净……”

3731b356-b0e0-4f9b-9fc4-b1bdb1ceff30/Opt.en: It appears your aptitude is indeed remarkable... (The way Wuzi speaks sounds strangely familiar, as if I have heard it before...)
3731b356-b0e0-4f9b-9fc4-b1bdb1ceff30/Opt.cn: 可见你确是慧根不浅……（无字说话这般口吻，倒似在哪里听过一般……）
3731b356-b0e0-4f9b-9fc4-b1bdb1ceff30/Opt.ru: Похоже, ваши способности действительно замечательны... (То, как говорит Вузи, звучит странно знакомо, как будто я слышал это раньше...)

f79fc6f1-9ed2-4989-bead-56c6d96fc318/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s remark brings Wuzi sudden clarity, and a look of surprise crosses his features.<NL>After a brief pause, Wuzi sighs gently and says with some regret:<NL>When one clings too deeply, whether to good intentions or to ill ones, inner demons may arise all the same...<NL>Maybe... this downpour that held me here, letting me encounter the benefactor and gain this counsel, was ordained by heaven."
f79fc6f1-9ed2-4989-bead-56c6d96fc318/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>如此一言，<NL>竟令无字醍醐灌顶，显出几分愕然之色。<NL>须臾，只听得无字轻轻一叹，怅然道：<NL>“执迷过深，无论心中所存是善念亦或恶念，竟皆能催生出心魔来……<NL>或许……这瓢泼大雨困我在此，令小僧得遇施主、受此点拨，亦是天意使然。”

fb5d75c5-0d29-44ec-9b29-2adef3796c09/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s remark brings Wuzi sudden clarity, and a look of surprise crosses his features.<NL>After a brief pause, Wuzi sighs gently and says with some regret:<NL>"So that is how it is... So long as my mind is unmoved by external things—neither seeing nor hearing—I may naturally remain untouched by inner demons...Maybe... this downpour that held me here, letting me encounter the benefactor and gain this counsel, was ordained by heaven."
fb5d75c5-0d29-44ec-9b29-2adef3796c09/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>如此一言，<NL>竟令无字醍醐灌顶，显出几分愕然之色。<NL>须臾，只听得无字轻轻一叹，怅然道：<NL>“原来如此……只要我心不为外物所动，不听不看，自能不受心魔侵扰……<NL>或许……这瓢泼大雨困我在此，令小僧得遇施主、受此点拨，亦是天意使然。”

6a9a0664-8201-40d7-978f-410a9f065c98/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s remark brings Wuzi sudden clarity, and a look of surprise crosses his features.<NL>After a brief pause, Wuzi sighs gently and says with some regret:<NL>"Though your words are plainspoken, they are not without truth. To dwell in empty contemplation is, in the end, of no avail...<NL>Maybe... this downpour that held me here, letting me encounter the benefactor and gain this counsel, was ordained by heaven."
6a9a0664-8201-40d7-978f-410a9f065c98/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>如此一言，<NL>竟令无字醍醐灌顶，显出几分愕然之色。<NL>须臾，只听得无字轻轻一叹，怅然道：<NL>“施主此话虽是直白，其中却不无道理，徒然空想，终究是无济于事……<NL>或许……这瓢泼大雨困我在此，令小僧得遇施主、受此点拨，亦是天意使然。”

a92b0221-3a7a-498a-87b0-c34ea0853b30/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s remark brings Wuzi sudden clarity, and a look of surprise crosses his features.<NL>After a brief pause, Wuzi sighs gently and says with some regret:<NL>"Such courage in your words, benefactor! If inner demons stand in the path, then cut them away entirely; when the demons are dispelled, the heart will find its own purity and calm...<NL>Maybe... this downpour that held me here, letting me encounter the benefactor and gain this counsel, was ordained by heaven."
a92b0221-3a7a-498a-87b0-c34ea0853b30/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>如此一言，<NL>竟令无字醍醐灌顶，显出几分愕然之色。<NL>须臾，只听得无字轻轻一叹，怅然道：<NL>“施主好一番魄力！既知心魔拦路，便索性断除心魔;心魔一去，心中自会清净无扰……<NL>或许……这瓢泼大雨困我在此，令小僧得遇施主、受此点拨，亦是天意使然。”

b3024548-970c-44ca-9e95-f10f9d0f3050/Eve.en: At these words, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> is suddenly overcome by a vague sense of familiarity lingering in the heart.<NL>Just as this thought takes shape, Wuzi speaks as well, his voice tinged with puzzlement:<NL>"I know not why, but whenever I converse with you, I feel an unusual affinity.<NL>It is as though we had met in a past life, and once shared some forgotten encounter..."
b3024548-970c-44ca-9e95-f10f9d0f3050/Eve.cn: 说至此处，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>莫名有种熟悉之感萦绕心头，<NL>正思量时，便听无字亦满怀疑惑道：<NL>“却不知是何缘由，小僧与施主相谈之时，总觉格外投缘，<NL>恍若前世便已与施主相逢，曾有一段过往际遇一般……”

b3024548-970c-44ca-9e95-f10f9d0f3050/Opt.en: (How strange indeed. I feel the same...)
b3024548-970c-44ca-9e95-f10f9d0f3050/Opt.ru: (Действительно, как странно. Я чувствую то же самое...)

0fe0a051-5061-4f54-b941-07b4b4bc99cb/Eve.en: Yet the workings of fate are subtle, beyond the knowing of human will.<NL>For a time, neither <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> nor Wuzi could find an answer, and so they let the matter rest.<NL><NL>At last, Wuzi smiles and says:<NL>"Today, thanks to your guidance, the knots in my heart have all been undone.<NL>I have resolved to set out for the Shaolin Temple tomorrow.<NL>If our karmic ties are not yet exhausted, then when you have leisure in days to come, you are most welcome to visit Shaolin Temple and share a talk with me..."
0fe0a051-5061-4f54-b941-07b4b4bc99cb/Eve.cn: 然而机缘巧妙，非人力所能知，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>与无字一时皆不得解，便只得暂且作罢。<NL><NL>那无字最后又笑道：<NL>“今日蒙施主指点迷津，<NL>小僧心中郁结尽散，决意明日便启程往少林寺去。<NL>倘若日后缘分未了，施主得闲时，便可来少林寺与小僧一叙……”

0fe0a051-5061-4f54-b941-07b4b4bc99cb/Opt.en: If our karmic ties are not yet spent, we shall meet again.
0fe0a051-5061-4f54-b941-07b4b4bc99cb/Opt.ru: Если наши кармические узы еще не разорваны, мы встретимся снова.

cc41cc3a-a1f9-413f-a689-412c3a8fefa9/Eve.en: When their conversation comes to an end, night has fallen further still.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> finds a separate chamber, kindles a fire, and makes ready to rest.<NL>With the rising warmth comes a wave of fatigue, and soon enough, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s mind drifts, slipping into heavy slumber...
cc41cc3a-a1f9-413f-a689-412c3a8fefa9/Eve.cn: 二人话罢，天色已愈发昏黑，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>便另寻一间厢房，生起火堆，收拾妥当，<NL>周身倦意随暖意一同涌上，不多时，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>便已神思迷糊，沉沉睡去……

39c4a8e9-d151-4112-a966-ca9ca3daa114/Eve.en: When <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> awakens the next day,<NL>the fire at <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> side has long gone cold, and all around is silent—Wuzi is nowhere to be seen.<NL>Looking outside the temple, the rain has passed and the clouds have cleared. It seems he has already set off for the Shaolin Temple...
39c4a8e9-d151-4112-a966-ca9ca3daa114/Eve.cn: 待得次日，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>再醒来时，<NL>只见身旁火堆已冷，四下一片空寂，早已不见无字的踪迹。<NL>再瞧庙外，雨散云收，想必其人已往少林寺行去……

39c4a8e9-d151-4112-a966-ca9ca3daa114/Opt.en: (When time permits, perhaps I should visit the Shaolin Temple...)
39c4a8e9-d151-4112-a966-ca9ca3daa114/Opt.cn: （待得闲暇，或可前去少林寺一探……）
39c4a8e9-d151-4112-a966-ca9ca3daa114/Opt.ru: (Когда позволит время, возможно, мне следует посетить храм Шаолинь...)

dad3621d-72d5-441b-8bcb-6b8d756c8754/Eve.en: This day, while <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> is passing the Shaolin Temple of Mt. Song,<NL>memories arise of the monk Wuzi encountered before. He had set his heart on Shaolin, hoping to enter the order and train in earnest.<NL>It remains unclear whether his aspiration has at last come true...
dad3621d-72d5-441b-8bcb-6b8d756c8754/Eve.cn: 此日，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>途经嵩山少林寺，<NL>忽忆起此前所遇的无字僧人。此僧曾言志在少林，愿能拜入门中，潜心修习，<NL>却不知如今是否已经心愿得偿……
dad3621d-72d5-441b-8bcb-6b8d756c8754/Eve.ru: В этот день, в то время как <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> проезжает мимо храма Шаолинь на горе Сун.,<NL>возникают воспоминания о Монахе, с которым Уци встречался раньше. Он всей душой стремился в Шаолинь, надеясь вступить в орден и серьезно тренироваться.<NL>Остается неясным, сбылось ли наконец его Устремление...

dad3621d-72d5-441b-8bcb-6b8d756c8754/Opt.en: (I wonder whether Wuzi has already been accepted into the Shaolin Temple...)
dad3621d-72d5-441b-8bcb-6b8d756c8754/Opt.cn: （也不知无字是否已经拜入少林寺中……）
dad3621d-72d5-441b-8bcb-6b8d756c8754/Opt.ru: (Интересно, был ли Уци уже принят в храм Шаолинь...)

e79d2a2e-040d-484b-a15a-2a6022f1d149/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> steps slowly into the Shaolin Temple,<NL>only to see many young disciples gathered together. At times they chant sutras in unison, at others they counsel and debate among themselves.<NL>For reasons unknown, traces of worry are plainly visible on the faces of all the monks.
e79d2a2e-040d-484b-a15a-2a6022f1d149/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>缓步迈入少林寺中，<NL>却见寺中诸多年轻弟子正围聚一处，时而齐声诵念经文、时而彼此劝诫论话，<NL>不知何故，众僧面上，竟皆有几分难掩的愁容。

e79d2a2e-040d-484b-a15a-2a6022f1d149/Opt.en: (Listen in to learn what they are discussing...)

11953095-d017-4348-aa13-56cb78389868/Eve.en: After making inquiries all around, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> finally learns the reason:<NL>It turns out that over the past several days, many disciples of the Shaolin Temple have been plagued by nightmares.<NL>Some dream of alluring demonesses entwining and tempting them. Others see Mara entering their bodies and tearing them open, demonic apparitions crowding their sleep and leaving their minds deeply unsettled.<NL>When the monks speak of this, they cannot help but reproach themselves—such weakness of will is truly a sin, a sin indeed...
11953095-d017-4348-aa13-56cb78389868/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>四下探问一番，方才知晓：<NL>原来数日以来，少林寺中不少弟子受噩梦所扰，<NL>或遇艳美魔女缠身蛊惑，或遭魔罗入腹开膛破肚，梦中魔影重重，直教人心神不宁。<NL>众僧说起此事，不免自愧：自己这般意志不坚，实在是罪过，罪过……

11953095-d017-4348-aa13-56cb78389868/Opt.en: (Inner demons entangling the mind, denying it peace... It bears some resemblance to Wuzi's troubles that day...)
11953095-d017-4348-aa13-56cb78389868/Opt.cn: （心魔纠缠，不得清净……倒是与那日无字的烦恼有几分相似………）
11953095-d017-4348-aa13-56cb78389868/Opt.ru: (Внутренние демоны опутывают разум, лишая его покоя... Это имеет некоторое сходство с неприятностями Вузи в тот день...)

01e397c3-b97c-4f1e-912e-8b621bfed4f0/Eve.en: Recalling the troubles Wuzi once faced,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> looks upon these Shaolin disciples and sees clearly that they are in the very same plight Wuzi once endured, and thus beset by similar vexations.<NL>With this realization, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> repeats, in full, the counsel once offered to Wuzi, relating it to the monks assembled...
01e397c3-b97c-4f1e-912e-8b621bfed4f0/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>思及此前无字所遇烦忧，<NL>眼观这些少林弟子，分明与当初的无字同样境遇，方才生出许多烦恼。<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>心下了然，随即便将此前开解无字的话语，也一一说与众僧知晓……

7a8fa18e-b797-4892-b65a-ff5aacd93080/Eve.en: The monks listen quietly to <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s words, palms pressed together, as if gaining some insight.<NL>At that moment, <CharacterOrActor key=Monk str=Name/> seems to sense the calm here and approaches slowly, bowing with joined palms toward <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>:<NL>"Amitabha... there is something you may not know...<NL>Our temple's disciples dare not treat these troubled dreams lightly, and there is a reason for that.<NL>Have you heard that matters such as demonesses' temptations and Mara entering the body are already recorded in the scriptures?<NL>It is said that such things are all the devices of the Mara Papiyan..."
7a8fa18e-b797-4892-b65a-ff5aacd93080/Eve.cn: 众僧静静听取<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>所言，双手合十，若有所悟。<NL>正在此时，<CharacterOrActor key=Monk str=Name/>似是察觉此间清净，徐徐走近，向<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>合掌一拜：<NL>“阿弥陀佛……施主有所不知……<NL>我寺弟子不敢轻忽这一枕痴梦，原是有缘故的。<NL>施主可曾听闻，诸如魔女蛊惑、魔罗入腹之事，经卷之中实则早有记述，<NL>据说如此这般，皆是魔王波旬的手段……”

89c0afb9-f384-457a-975c-22a1eb6504d3/Eve.en: <CharacterOrActor key=Monk str=Name/> then briefly recounts what is recorded in the scriptures:<NL><NL>According to the texts, Mara Papiyan once sent demonesses to beguile the Buddha,<NL>and later transformed into malevolent spirits, burrowing into the bodies of the Buddha's disciples to sow chaos.<NL>When the Buddha was on the verge of attaining enlightenment, Papiyan even led a host of demons in full assault,<NL>seeking to block his path through terror and temptation alike.<NL>Yet all these stratagems were seen through by the Buddha.<NL>With no schemes left to employ, Papiyan was ultimately defeated by the Buddha's steadfast resolve, supreme wisdom, and boundless compassion...
89c0afb9-f384-457a-975c-22a1eb6504d3/Eve.cn: <CharacterOrActor key=Monk str=Name/>随后便将经书中所载之事，简而言之：<NL><NL>据经中记载，魔王波旬曾派魔女蛊惑佛陀，<NL>后又暗化邪祟，钻入佛陀弟子腹中作乱；<NL>待得佛陀即将道成之时，波旬更率魔军倾力来攻，<NL>既以凶威震慑，又以利诱欺骗，欲断佛陀证道之路。<NL>然而这诸多伎俩，皆被佛陀识破，<NL>波旬计无所施，最终败于佛陀的坚韧心性、无上智慧与大慈大悲之下……

fec5b677-f8c5-488f-b30d-b687b9ddaf45/Eve.en: With those words spoken, <CharacterOrActor key=Monk str=Name/> sighs softly once more:<NL>"Still... there is something I cannot comprehend.<NL>How could so many of our Shaolin disciples, without cause, all give rise to inner demons at this same time and see such countless demonic visions in their dreams?<NL>Might this unusual phenomenon be a Chan test laid down by the Buddha, to refine our disciples' resolve..."<NL><NL>At this, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> recalls that within Shaolin there lies a place indeed shrouded in manifold demonic apparitions.<NL>Could there be some link between that place and the monks' sudden afflictions...
fec5b677-f8c5-488f-b30d-b687b9ddaf45/Eve.cn: 话音落下，<CharacterOrActor key=Monk str=Name/>又轻轻一叹：<NL>“然则……此中却有一事，令我不解。<NL>我少林寺中诸多弟子，怎会平白无故间，尽皆在此时生出心魔，梦见重重魔影？<NL>此般异状，莫非是佛祖设下禅关，以此磨砺我寺弟子心性不成……”<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>听得此言，忽而思及这少林寺中，却有一处地界，当真暗藏重重魔影，<NL>不知与寺中众僧忽生异梦，可有什么关联……

fec5b677-f8c5-488f-b30d-b687b9ddaf45/Opt.en: (Could the demonic apparitions that haunt their dreams be linked to those lurking in the Bodhidharma Cave...)
fec5b677-f8c5-488f-b30d-b687b9ddaf45/Opt.cn: （不知众僧梦中魔影，是否与达摩洞中那些魔影有所关联……）
fec5b677-f8c5-488f-b30d-b687b9ddaf45/Opt.ru: (Могут ли демонические видения, которые преследуют их во сне, быть связаны с теми, кто скрывается в пещере Бодхидхармы...)

f2096137-624c-4edd-bd1c-bff01fe93d21/Eve.en: A thought stirs in <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s mind:<NL>The Bodhidharma Cave of Shaolin is known to harbor innumerable demonic apparitions that refuse to fade.<NL>If the monks' unusual dreams truly stem from demonic influence, then the apparitions within the cave may reveal some anomaly as well.<NL>Considering this, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> decides to visit the Bodhidharma Cave when an opportunity arises...
f2096137-624c-4edd-bd1c-bff01fe93d21/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>心中暗想，<NL>少林寺中达摩洞，其中正有无数魔头魔影徘徊不去。<NL>此间众僧异梦若当真与魔有关，或许那洞中魔影，亦会显出几分异状，<NL>思及此处，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>便即决意，待得闲暇之时，当往达摩洞中一探……

f2096137-624c-4edd-bd1c-bff01fe93d21/Opt.en: (Better to head to the Bodhidharma Cave and see for myself...)
f2096137-624c-4edd-bd1c-bff01fe93d21/Opt.ru: (Лучше отправиться в пещеру Бодхидхармы и посмотреть самому...)

31e20d7c-6959-427a-9272-9bdb6bce968d/Eve.en: As the young monks of Shaolin suffer one troubled dream after another,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> recalls the demonic apparitions that haunt the Bodhidharma Cave—this place may well have shifted as well.<NL>Arriving before the cave, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> senses that the presence within feels faintly unlike it once did, carrying a hint of anomaly.<NL><NL>With composure gathered, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> prepares to enter...
31e20d7c-6959-427a-9272-9bdb6bce968d/Eve.cn: 少林寺中，一众年轻僧人异梦连连，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>由此思及达摩洞中魔影徘徊，此处说不得亦有异动，<NL>寻至达摩洞前，果真察觉洞内气息隐隐与往日不同，似藏着几分异样。<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>随即整理心神，准备踏入其中……

710f95cb-1c9d-4ad2-9462-3e2946b5678c/Eve.en: With measured steps, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> enters the Bodhidharma Cave.<NL>The surroundings are dark, chill, and hushed.<NL>The apparitions that once wandered here have utterly disappeared, leaving not the slightest sign behind.<NL>Peering into the depths, the cavern extends into shadow without end—what secrets might lurk within that darkness...
710f95cb-1c9d-4ad2-9462-3e2946b5678c/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>缓步迈入达摩洞中，<NL>见四下昏黑，寒凉静谧，<NL>此前洞内盘桓的魔影却是浑然不见，全无踪迹！<NL>再望洞穴深处，幽邃深长，不见尽头，不知阴翳之中又会暗藏何种玄机……

8ad91518-2a80-42b7-8dd7-84277417a43e/Eve.en: Tracing the cave's path, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> presses deeper into the Bodhidharma Cave...<NL><NL>After half a moment's journey, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> arrives at the cave's end—yet instead of a rock wall, there stands a massive green-stone gate reaching up to the ceiling!<NL>Set into the rock face and veiled in layers of dust, it seems as though it has existed since time immemorial.<NL>Upon its surface faint patterns of entwined lotus vines can be glimpsed, with wisps of carved clouds unfolding like drifting mist,<NL>though age has worn them smooth, leaving only the vaguest trace of their ancient artistry...
8ad91518-2a80-42b7-8dd7-84277417a43e/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>顺着洞道，往达摩洞中更深处探去……<NL><NL>如此走了半刻，终至洞底，眼前却非石壁，而是一扇高至洞顶的青石大门！<NL>此门嵌壁而生，覆满尘灰，其形其貌好似古已有之；<NL>门上隐约能见缠枝莲花交错缠绕，缕缕流云如气团舒展，<NL>却因岁月磨洗而模糊不清，只留几分朦胧古意……

8ad91518-2a80-42b7-8dd7-84277417a43e/Opt.en: A stone door hidden within the Bodhidharma Cave?! (Try to push it open...)
8ad91518-2a80-42b7-8dd7-84277417a43e/Opt.cn: 达摩洞中竟还藏有如此石门！（尝试推门……）
8ad91518-2a80-42b7-8dd7-84277417a43e/Opt.ru: Каменная дверь, скрытая в пещере Бодхидхармы?! (Попробуй открыть ее...)

3c86cbd1-6323-4145-870e-fc3dbbc92d1f/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> reaches out and tests the door with a shove,<NL>but it remains utterly unmoved, as if grown from the very stone of the cave.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> then channels <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> inner strength to drive against it, even attempting to batter it with sheer force, but it proves equally futile—there is not the faintest shift...
3c86cbd1-6323-4145-870e-fc3dbbc92d1f/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>抬手先是一推，<NL>那石门却是纹丝不动，仿佛早与石壁融作一处；<NL>继而凝气发力推击，又或凭蛮力硬撼，也始终未能让它挪动半分……

3c86cbd1-6323-4145-870e-fc3dbbc92d1f/Opt.en: (Step closer and examine the door carefully...)

e41c1d01-b312-46a1-91a3-b98386e6adb8/Eve.en: A sense of wonder stirs within <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>.<NL>Drawing nearer, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> observes that the door bears neither lock nor device.<NL>Instead, faintly etched between the door's edges lies a line of verse, obscure yet suggestive:<NL>"Six Paths and Threefold Realm, immeasurable and wide—<NL>Transcend your bounds in spirit, and thus arrive at the Garden of Purity."
e41c1d01-b312-46a1-91a3-b98386e6adb8/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>心中称奇，<NL>凑近细观，便见门身既无锁眼，也无机关痕迹，<NL>唯独门缝之间，寻得一句似是而非的偈语：<NL>「六趣三界，广大无边，神游界外，方至净园」……

0b16e9c7-22ca-41d0-866e-e392f7f291d7/Eve.en: A thought strikes <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>.<NL>If the spirit must travel beyond the bounds, there is an object already at hand capable of such a feat.<NL>The Void Qi acquired upon Wudang Mountains originates from beyond this realm itself.<NL>By circulating it through breath and meditation, one may evoke the feeling of roaming beyond the bounds—this does match the meaning hidden within the verse...
0b16e9c7-22ca-41d0-866e-e392f7f291d7/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>忽而想起，<NL>若欲神游界外，自己正有一物，能堪此用。<NL>此前于武当山所得的空无一炁，原本便生于此世间之外，<NL>若是借由此炁，吐纳调息，便能生出神游天外之感，岂不恰合此偈语所言……

0b16e9c7-22ca-41d0-866e-e392f7f291d7/Opt.en: (Take out the Void Qi and begin to meditate)

27d68a67-6a14-43a9-8f4a-5c6bd4d832f7/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> takes out the black-and-white entwined Void Qi and gently presses it with a palm, dispersing it.<NL>The Void Qi rises like mist, slowly drawn into <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s body and settling within <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> Dantian.<NL>In an instant, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> spirit trembles and drifts. As <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> breath is regulated, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> Dantian feels boundless as the Great Void, and the True Qi within seems inexhaustible...<NL><NL>In but twenty fleeting instants, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> senses the mysteries of heaven and earth laid bare.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=UpperGenderPossessive/> soul seems to part from <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> body, entering a realm beyond the skies, and a breath of True Qi escapes the lips.<NL>That breath floats lightly, thinning into strands that slip through the seam of the stone door.<NL>Before long, the massive door opens soundlessly...
27d68a67-6a14-43a9-8f4a-5c6bd4d832f7/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>取出黑白相缠的空无一炁，以掌轻推，将其化开，<NL>只见那炁如烟雾般升腾而起，徐徐被<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>吸入体内，归入气海之中。<NL>刹然间，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>只觉心魂一荡，神思飘然，<NL>运气调息之时，气海便如太虚般无边无垠，浑身真气更似无穷无尽……<NL><NL>弹指间二十刹那，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>恍觉洞彻天地玄机，<NL>魂离此身，如入天外之境，不由得张口吐出一口真气，<NL>只见那口真气飘飘悠悠，化作细丝，钻过石门缝隙，<NL>不多时，那石门便悄然敞开……

2d1bbd47-c3d7-4929-ae55-285984e346bb/Eve.en: Peering inside, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> senses a trace of familiar presence rising from afar.<NL>The interior, however, lies cloaked in murk, its features utterly obscured.<NL>Perhaps only by entering can its mystery be uncovered...
2d1bbd47-c3d7-4929-ae55-285984e346bb/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>望向门内，<NL>隐隐觉察一缕熟悉的气息，自深处而来；<NL>然而门内昏蒙无比，其中景象却是半点看不分明，<NL>只怕非得踏入门内，方能探明究竟……
2d1bbd47-c3d7-4929-ae55-285984e346bb/Eve.ru: Заглядываю внутрь, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> ощущает след знакомого присутствия, доносящийся издалека.<NL>Интерьер, однако, окутан мраком, его черты совершенно скрыты.<NL>Возможно, только войдя внутрь, можно раскрыть его тайну...

2d1bbd47-c3d7-4929-ae55-285984e346bb/Opt.cn: 不入虎穴不得虎子……（步入其中……）
2d1bbd47-c3d7-4929-ae55-285984e346bb/Opt.ru: Никто не рисковал, ничего не выигрывал... (Шагни внутрь...)

6cd02baa-fbe5-42b1-abd6-08e0020fd8c1/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> looked ahead and stepped steadily through the stone gate.<NL>After only a few steps, the world suddenly opened up like a painted scroll before his eyes—<NL>Inside the gate was a serene and beautiful garden.<NL>Bodhi trees swayed with lush green shadows, twin sala trees intertwined with gnarled branches,<NL>and a lotus pond lay clear as a mirror, white lotus flowers drifting upon its surface, reflecting sky and clouds...<NL><NL>In the distance across the pond, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> saw a familiar figure seated beneath a bodhi tree—<NL>faint and misty, yet unmistakably Bodhidharma!
6cd02baa-fbe5-42b1-abd6-08e0020fd8c1/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>目视前方，稳步走入石门。<NL>不过数步，便觉豁然开朗，万物如画卷般在眼前铺展而开——<NL>原来石门之内，竟是一座秀美静谧的花园，<NL>园中菩提树翠影婆娑，娑罗双树虬枝交映，<NL>一方莲花池澄澈如镜，池中漂浮朵朵素白莲花，花下水面温润，映出天光云影……<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>遥遥望去，在那莲花池的彼岸，<NL>有一道熟悉身影坐在菩提树下，依稀朦胧，却赫然是达摩祖师！

6cd02baa-fbe5-42b1-abd6-08e0020fd8c1/Opt.en: (Patriarch Bodhidharma is here in this garden!)

6421f0bf-2ccc-4151-b275-397875d9e542/Eve.en: A chill runs through <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s soul,<NL>and in that instant <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> senses as if an immense burden has fallen away, leaving not the faintest worry behind.<NL>It dawns upon <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderObject/> that this garden is indeed like a vision from a dream, wondrous and unfathomable, nothing akin to the world of men...
6421f0bf-2ccc-4151-b275-397875d9e542/Eve.cn: 继而，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>神魂一凛，<NL>惊觉心中竟似卸下千斤重担一般，已浑无半点烦恼萦绕，<NL>方知此间园林果真如梦似幻，玄虚奥妙，全然不似凡间现世……

6421f0bf-2ccc-4151-b275-397875d9e542/Opt.en: (This place is most strange—better seek Patriarch Bodhidharma and ask him directly...)
6421f0bf-2ccc-4151-b275-397875d9e542/Opt.cn: （此地好生奇怪，不如前去寻大师一问……）
6421f0bf-2ccc-4151-b275-397875d9e542/Opt.ru: (Это место самое странное — лучше найдите патриарха Бодхидхарму и спросите его напрямую...)

076adf5e-e492-44b8-ac77-0cbee46e4f4f/Eve.en: With doubts stirring in <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s heart,<NL>and recalling that Patriarch Bodhidharma dwells within this garden—perhaps knowing its true nature—<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> lifts a foot and makes toward where the Patriarch sits...
076adf5e-e492-44b8-ac77-0cbee46e4f4f/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>心存疑虑，<NL>思及达摩祖师身在此园，或许知晓此园究竟，<NL>便即抬步，欲往达摩祖师所在寻去……
076adf5e-e492-44b8-ac77-0cbee46e4f4f/Eve.ru: С сомнениями, шевелящимися в <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>чье-то сердце,<NL>и вспоминая, что патриарх Бодхидхарма обитает в этом саду — возможно, зная его истинную природу—<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> поднимает ногу и направляется к тому месту, где сидит Патриарх...

8f83e260-4045-41ea-b419-36749615703c/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> proceeds onward,<NL>treading lightly across the lush, overgrown grasses and passing between several twin sala trees.<NL>The moment he steps beyond the shade, a soft laugh rings out, and a maiden clad in a thin robe suddenly appears before <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderObject/>.<NL>Her beauty is delicate and radiant, her eyes like autumn waters. In every gesture she is gentle and graceful,<NL>as though she has long been waiting here for <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>...
8f83e260-4045-41ea-b419-36749615703c/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>一路前行，<NL>缓步踏过葳蕤草地，穿过数棵娑罗双树，<NL>待得走出树影的那一刹那，便听得几声轻笑，一名身着薄衫的少女忽现眼前。<NL>只见这少女容色娇妍，目若秋水，举手投足间端的是柔婉清丽，<NL>好似早已在此等待<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>多时……

b867a2ab-a535-4e5c-939f-681f00648d70/Eve.en: The girl offers a graceful smile.<NL>Drawing near to <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>, she murmurs softly,<NL>"There is no need for fear. I have been sent by the Divine themselves to serve you.<NL>Let me remain at your side, to dispel your cares and share in your joy.<NL>From this moment on, my fate rests in your hands, and I shall follow your will in all things..."<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> falters slightly in step.<NL>Somehow, a tender and enchanting fragrance now fills the space.<NL>Amid its drifting sweetness, his senses blur, and only the thought of abandoning all worldly burdens for pleasure remains,<NL>with no desire left to endure the hardships of mortal life...
b867a2ab-a535-4e5c-939f-681f00648d70/Eve.cn: 那少女盈盈一笑，<NL>行至<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>近前，低声道：<NL>“施主莫怕，莫慌，奴家不过是天神特意遣来，赠予施主的侍奉之人。<NL>只愿能伴施主遣怀取乐，同享欢愉，<NL>此身从此便由施主做主，奴家自当一一依从……”<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>脚步微微一顿，<NL>不知何时，此间竟漫起一股绵柔惑人的异香，<NL>氤氲馥郁间，竟觉神智渐昏，满心只余下抛却诸事、寻欢作乐之念，<NL>再不愿受此世间的半分苦楚……

b867a2ab-a535-4e5c-939f-681f00648d70/Opt.en: (So this must be the demonic apparition that beguiled Wuzi and the Shaolin monks...)
b867a2ab-a535-4e5c-939f-681f00648d70/Opt.cn: （看来此人便是无字与少林众僧所见，蛊惑人心的魔影……）
b867a2ab-a535-4e5c-939f-681f00648d70/Opt.ru: (Так это, должно быть, и есть то демоническое видение, которое обмануло Уци и Монахов Шаолиня...)

beac2942-7c20-472c-bc87-1be8acd85302/Eve.en: When the maiden finishes speaking,<NL>she leans softly into <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s embrace, taking one of <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s hands and guiding it gently to her cheek.<NL>Her eyes shimmer as she tilts her face upward, gazing at <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> with tender allure:<NL>"You bear rare talent, having already set foot upon the Tao.<NL>Why continue to endure the hardships of cultivation and the trials of tempering?<NL>Within this pure land, simply indulge in joy, lie drunk in bliss—such freedom is what you truly deserve..."<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> recalls what Wuzi and the Shaolin monks once beheld,<NL>and remembers the scriptures' account of Mara Papiyan.<NL>In a flash of thought, the truth of her nature becomes clear.<NL>Without revealing a trace of emotion, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> withdraws his hand and says...
beac2942-7c20-472c-bc87-1be8acd85302/Eve.cn: 少女说罢，<NL>轻轻偎入<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>怀中，执起<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>一手，引他轻抚自己脸颊，<NL>竟而眼波流转，昂头望向<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>，楚楚动人道：<NL>“施主身负奇才，既已踏足大道，<NL>又何苦再受那修行之苦、遭那磨砺之罪？<NL>入此净土，只管纵情享乐、醉卧欢娱，本就是施主该得的自在……”<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>便又念及无字与少林众僧此前所见，<NL>忆起经卷之中所载、魔王波旬之事，心念电转之间，便已看穿此人来历，<NL>随即不动声色，抽回手道……

beac2942-7c20-472c-bc87-1be8acd85302/Opt.en: Xiangshu remains unvanquished and demonic apparitions run rampant—what "Tao" could there be in such a place?
beac2942-7c20-472c-bc87-1be8acd85302/Opt.cn: 相枢未除，魔影作乱，此处何来大道？
beac2942-7c20-472c-bc87-1be8acd85302/Opt.ru: Сяншу остается непобежденным, и демонические явления свирепствуют — какое "Дао" может быть в таком месте?

beac2942-7c20-472c-bc87-1be8acd85302/Opt.en: If this were truly a Pure Land, then how could you—someone whose heart is tainted by mortal desire—dwell within it...?
beac2942-7c20-472c-bc87-1be8acd85302/Opt.cn: 若此地当真是一方净土，你心染尘俗，又怎会在此……
beac2942-7c20-472c-bc87-1be8acd85302/Opt.ru: Если бы это действительно была Чистая Земля, то как бы ты — тот, чье сердце запятнано смертным желанием — мог жить в ней...?

beac2942-7c20-472c-bc87-1be8acd85302/Opt.en: I have pressing matters to attend to and no time for idle talk. Do not bar my path...
beac2942-7c20-472c-bc87-1be8acd85302/Opt.cn: 我有要事在身，无暇与你多言，你勿要阻我去路……
beac2942-7c20-472c-bc87-1be8acd85302/Opt.ru: У меня есть неотложные дела, которыми я должен заняться, и нет времени на пустые разговоры. Не преграждай мне путь...

beac2942-7c20-472c-bc87-1be8acd85302/Opt.en: Alas, alas—beneath that fair skin of yours, I fear there is nothing at all. You are hardly worthy of me...
beac2942-7c20-472c-bc87-1be8acd85302/Opt.cn: 唉呀唉呀，只怕你皮囊之下空空如也，实在是配不上我……
beac2942-7c20-472c-bc87-1be8acd85302/Opt.ru: Увы, увы — боюсь, что под твоей светлой кожей вообще ничего нет. Ты едва ли достоин меня...

beac2942-7c20-472c-bc87-1be8acd85302/Opt.en: I have roamed the martial world, slaying gods that block me and demons that oppose me. Do you truly wish to test that for yourself?
beac2942-7c20-472c-bc87-1be8acd85302/Opt.cn: 我纵横江湖，向来神挡杀神、魔挡杀魔，莫非你是想亲眼见识见识？
beac2942-7c20-472c-bc87-1be8acd85302/Opt.ru: Я бродил по Миру боевых искусств, убивая богов, которые блокируют меня, и демонов, которые противостоят мне. Вы действительно хотите проверить это на себе?

f8a29ec4-2527-431a-9179-5fe074e5da5a/Eve.en: With his heart now steadfast and utterly unmoved,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> beholds the maiden sigh softly, remarking only that such is the way of true cultivation.<NL>Her figure then melts into a veil of mist and fades from sight...<NL><NL>The murky air clears away, and <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s awareness grows lucid once more.<NL>Across the garden, beneath the Bodhi tree, Patriarch Bodhidharma remains as immovable as a stone, unmoving as ever...
f8a29ec4-2527-431a-9179-5fe074e5da5a/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>心念既净，再无半分动摇，<NL>又见那少女轻轻一叹，只道修行之路，当如是法。<NL>此后，其身其形便化作一团朦胧雾气，转瞬散去……<NL><NL>此地浊气尽散，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>神智重归清明，<NL>遥遥望向菩提树下，仍见达摩祖师端立如磐、分毫未动……

After a hundred paces, it feels as though weighed down by a crushing burden...
