b835d705-26f1-4233-af0e-6f4ff2156b35/Opt.cn: （看来此人便是无字与少林众僧所见，蛊惑人心的魔影……）
b835d705-26f1-4233-af0e-6f4ff2156b35/Opt.ru: (Так это, должно быть, и есть то демоническое видение, которое обмануло Уци и Монахов Шаолиня...)

b227db1b-f169-4b5e-8fc2-f774b5742cc8/Eve.en: When the young man finishes speaking,<NL>he gently takes <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s hand, taking one of <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s hands, cradling her fingertips in his palm and guiding them to lift his chin.<NL>Dropping to one knee, he gazes up at <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> with a fleeting, enigmatic smile:<NL>"You bear rare talent, having already set foot upon the Tao.<NL>Why continue to endure the hardships of cultivation and the trials of tempering?<NL>Within this pure land, simply indulge in joy, lie drunk in bliss—such freedom is what you truly deserve..."<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> recalls what Wuzi and the Shaolin monks once beheld,<NL>and remembers the scriptures' account of Mara Papiyan.<NL>In a flash of thought, the truth of his nature becomes clear.<NL>Without revealing a trace of emotion, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> withdraws her hand and says...
b227db1b-f169-4b5e-8fc2-f774b5742cc8/Eve.cn: 少年说罢，<NL>轻轻执起<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>指尖，捧在掌心，引她轻抬自己颌下，<NL>竟而单膝跪地，昂头望向<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>，似笑非笑道：<NL>“施主身负奇才，既已踏足大道，<NL>又何苦再受那修行之苦、遭那磨砺之罪？<NL>入此净土，只管纵情享乐、醉卧欢娱，本就是施主该得的自在……”<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>便又念及无字与少林众僧此前所见，<NL>忆起经卷之中所载、魔王波旬之事，心念电转之间，便已看穿此人来历，<NL>随即不动声色，抽回手道……

b227db1b-f169-4b5e-8fc2-f774b5742cc8/Opt.en: Xiangshu remains unvanquished and demonic apparitions run rampant—what "Tao" could there be in such a place?
b227db1b-f169-4b5e-8fc2-f774b5742cc8/Opt.cn: 相枢未除，魔影作乱，此处何来大道？
b227db1b-f169-4b5e-8fc2-f774b5742cc8/Opt.ru: Сяншу остается непобежденным, и демонические явления свирепствуют — какое "Дао" может быть в таком месте?

b227db1b-f169-4b5e-8fc2-f774b5742cc8/Opt.en: If this were truly a Pure Land, then how could you—someone whose heart is tainted by mortal desire—dwell within it...?
b227db1b-f169-4b5e-8fc2-f774b5742cc8/Opt.cn: 若此地当真是一方净土，你心染尘俗，又怎会在此……
b227db1b-f169-4b5e-8fc2-f774b5742cc8/Opt.ru: Если бы это действительно была Чистая Земля, то как бы ты — тот, чье сердце запятнано смертным желанием — мог жить в ней...?

b227db1b-f169-4b5e-8fc2-f774b5742cc8/Opt.en: I have pressing matters to attend to and no time for idle talk. Do not bar my path...
b227db1b-f169-4b5e-8fc2-f774b5742cc8/Opt.cn: 我有要事在身，无暇与你多言，你勿要阻我去路……
b227db1b-f169-4b5e-8fc2-f774b5742cc8/Opt.ru: У меня есть неотложные дела, которыми я должен заняться, и нет времени на пустые разговоры. Не преграждай мне путь...

b227db1b-f169-4b5e-8fc2-f774b5742cc8/Opt.en: Alas, alas—beneath that fair skin of yours, I fear there is nothing at all. You are hardly worthy of me...
b227db1b-f169-4b5e-8fc2-f774b5742cc8/Opt.cn: 唉呀唉呀，只怕你皮囊之下空空如也，实在是配不上我……
b227db1b-f169-4b5e-8fc2-f774b5742cc8/Opt.ru: Увы, увы — боюсь, что под твоей светлой кожей вообще ничего нет. Ты едва ли достоин меня...

b227db1b-f169-4b5e-8fc2-f774b5742cc8/Opt.en: I have roamed the martial world, slaying gods that block me and demons that oppose me. Do you truly wish to test that for yourself?
b227db1b-f169-4b5e-8fc2-f774b5742cc8/Opt.cn: 我纵横江湖，向来神挡杀神、魔挡杀魔，莫非你是想亲眼见识见识？
b227db1b-f169-4b5e-8fc2-f774b5742cc8/Opt.ru: Я бродил по Миру боевых искусств, убивая богов, которые блокируют меня, и демонов, которые противостоят мне. Вы действительно хотите проверить это на себе?

4b3720ac-1eb3-4e8c-9e77-1282e69eb29e/Eve.en: With her heart now steadfast and utterly unmoved,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> beholds the young man sigh softly, remarking only that such is the way of true cultivation.<NL>His figure then melts into a veil of mist and fades from sight...<NL><NL>The murky air clears away, and <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s awareness grows lucid once more.<NL>Across the garden, beneath the Bodhi tree, Patriarch Bodhidharma remains as immovable as a stone, unmoving as ever...
4b3720ac-1eb3-4e8c-9e77-1282e69eb29e/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>心念既净，再无半分动摇，<NL>又见那少年轻轻一叹，只道修行之路，当如是法。<NL>此后，其身其形便化作一团朦胧雾气，转瞬散去……<NL><NL>此地浊气尽散，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>神智重归清明，<NL>遥遥望向菩提树下，仍见达摩祖师端立如磐、分毫未动……

53d81a1f-c41a-4c5a-86e3-5a097524c1a3/Eve.en: With her heart now steadfast and utterly unmoved,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> beholds the young man smile softly and say: "If your heart is impure, you shall see me once more."<NL>His figure then melts into a veil of mist and fades from sight...<NL><NL>The murky air clears away, and <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s awareness grows lucid once more.<NL>Across the garden, beneath the Bodhi tree, Patriarch Bodhidharma remains as immovable as a stone, unmoving as ever...
53d81a1f-c41a-4c5a-86e3-5a097524c1a3/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>心念既净，再无半分动摇，<NL>又见那少年轻轻一笑，只道：“心若不净，便将见我。”<NL>此后，其身其形便化作一团朦胧雾气，转瞬散去……<NL><NL>此地浊气尽散，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>神智重归清明，<NL>遥遥望向菩提树下，仍见达摩祖师端立如磐、分毫未动……

2f7b32cc-f339-4b9a-be19-c252dfea29a9/Eve.en: With her heart now steadfast and utterly unmoved,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> beholds the young man slowly shed tears and murmur: "If your mind and vision are void, how would you even take notice of me?"<NL>His figure then melts into a veil of mist and fades from sight...<NL><NL>The murky air clears away, and <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s awareness grows lucid once more.<NL>Across the garden, beneath the Bodhi tree, Patriarch Bodhidharma remains as immovable as a stone, unmoving as ever...
2f7b32cc-f339-4b9a-be19-c252dfea29a9/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>心念既净，再无半分动摇，<NL>又见那少年哈哈一笑，只道：“施主心眼皆空，如何会将我放在眼里？”<NL>此后，其身其形便化作一团朦胧雾气，转瞬散去……<NL><NL>此地浊气尽散，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>神智重归清明，<NL>遥遥望向菩提树下，仍见达摩祖师端立如磐、分毫未动……

c77e777a-a759-4340-b43d-ef93d51a4292/Eve.en: With his heart now steadfast and utterly unmoved,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> beholds the young man reveal a flash of irritation, yet he remains speechless, forced only to glare in bitterness.<NL>His figure then melts into a veil of mist and fades from sight...<NL><NL>The murky air clears away, and <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s awareness grows lucid once more.<NL>Across the garden, beneath the Bodhi tree, Patriarch Bodhidharma remains as immovable as a stone, unmoving as ever...
c77e777a-a759-4340-b43d-ef93d51a4292/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>心念既净，再无半分动摇，<NL>又见那少年显出恼意，却又无言以对，只得恨恨望向<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>，<NL>其身其形渐渐化作一团朦胧雾气，转瞬散去……<NL><NL>此地浊气尽散，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>神智重归清明，<NL>遥遥望向菩提树下，仍见达摩祖师端立如磐、分毫未动……

814fbaf5-0e56-4810-8071-ed836ad9d70f/Eve.en: With her heart now steadfast and utterly unmoved,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> beholds the young man's expression shift to shock, terror rising within him. At once his body dissolves into a veil of mist,<NL>fading from sight entirely...<NL><NL>The murky air clears away, and <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s awareness grows lucid once more.<NL>Across the garden, beneath the Bodhi tree, Patriarch Bodhidharma remains as immovable as a stone, unmoving as ever...
814fbaf5-0e56-4810-8071-ed836ad9d70f/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>心念既净，再无半分动摇，<NL>又见那少年神色一惊，一时又惧又怕，其身其形霎时化作一团朦胧雾气，<NL>消散无影无踪……<NL><NL>此地浊气尽散，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>神智重归清明，<NL>遥遥望向菩提树下，仍见达摩祖师端立如磐、分毫未动……

8c17522e-a002-4342-a077-767c207cbeba/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> proceeds onward,<NL>treading lightly across the lush, overgrown grasses and passing between several twin sala trees.<NL>The moment <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> steps beyond the shade, a soft rustling breaks the silence—a snow-white, fluffy rabbit suddenly leaps out from the thicket.<NL>Its fur is pristine and spotless, its downy coat soft and full. With a gentle twitch of its ears,<NL>the creature comes hopping toward <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>...
8c17522e-a002-4342-a077-767c207cbeba/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>一路前行，<NL>缓步踏过葳蕤草地，穿过数棵娑罗双树，<NL>待得走出树影的那一刹那，便听得窸窣之声，竟是一只雪白毛绒的白兔，忽而自草丛中跃出。<NL>只见这白兔皮毛洁白无垢，绒毛蓬松，轻轻抖动耳朵间，<NL>便向<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>蹦跳而来……

8c17522e-a002-4342-a077-767c207cbeba/Opt.en: So it is a white rabbit...

070a3536-87bb-442c-8b09-ccab2d30c833/Eve.en: That white rabbit hops to <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s feet,<NL> then, quite unexpectedly, rises onto its hind legs and lightly pats at <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> with its forepaws.<NL>Its eyes are clear and endearing, as though it seeks food—or perhaps play.<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> cannot help but feel a surge of tenderness, utterly forgetting the purpose of the journey ahead.<NL>Just as <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> moves to sit and play with the creature, a sudden turn of thought flickers through <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> heart...
070a3536-87bb-442c-8b09-ccab2d30c833/Eve.cn: 那白兔跳到<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>足下，<NL>竟双足直立起来，前爪轻扑<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>，<NL>一双眼睛清澈可爱，好似欲要讨食、玩耍一般。<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>不由得心生怜爱，浑然忘却自己前行目的；<NL>正欲就地一坐，与那白兔嬉戏玩闹时，恍惚间，心神却忽地一转……

070a3536-87bb-442c-8b09-ccab2d30c833/Opt.en: (Is this rabbit the demonic apparition that beguiled Wuzi and the Shaolin monks?)
070a3536-87bb-442c-8b09-ccab2d30c833/Opt.cn: （莫非这白兔，亦是无字与少林众僧所见，蛊惑人心的魔影？）
070a3536-87bb-442c-8b09-ccab2d30c833/Opt.ru: (Является ли этот кролик демоническим привидением, которое обмануло Уци и Монахов Шаолиня?)

aad1afe2-990a-474e-8ce4-931ab467b9f6/Eve.en: The white rabbit then nuzzles against <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s palm,<NL> its tail wagging incessantly in pitiful supplication. So intimate a manner truly does not resemble that of any ordinary beast.<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> recalls what Wuzi and the Shaolin monks once beheld,<NL>and remembers the scriptures' account of Mara Papiyan.<NL>In a flash of thought, the truth of this creature's nature becomes clear...
aad1afe2-990a-474e-8ce4-931ab467b9f6/Eve.cn: 那白兔继而轻蹭<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>手心，<NL>不住摇尾乞怜，如此亲近之貌，却当真不似寻常兽物。<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>便又念及无字与少林众僧此前所见，<NL>忆起经卷之中所载、魔王波旬之事，心念电转之间，便已看穿这白兔的来历……

aad1afe2-990a-474e-8ce4-931ab467b9f6/Opt.en: How could a lone wild rabbit draw so near to a stranger? All this before my eyes is but illusion...
aad1afe2-990a-474e-8ce4-931ab467b9f6/Opt.cn: 茕茕野兔，如何会这般亲近生人？此情此景，皆是虚妄……
aad1afe2-990a-474e-8ce4-931ab467b9f6/Opt.ru: Как мог одинокий дикий кролик подобраться так близко к незнакомцу? Все это перед моими глазами - всего лишь иллюзия...

aad1afe2-990a-474e-8ce4-931ab467b9f6/Opt.en: All beings are worthy of compassion. How can I cling only to pity for this rabbit before me? All this is but illusion...
aad1afe2-990a-474e-8ce4-931ab467b9f6/Opt.cn: 众生可怜，我岂能独怜眼前白兔？此情此景，皆是虚妄……
aad1afe2-990a-474e-8ce4-931ab467b9f6/Opt.ru: Все существа достойны сострадания. Как я могу цепляться только за жалость к этому кролику передо мной? Все это всего лишь иллюзия...

aad1afe2-990a-474e-8ce4-931ab467b9f6/Opt.en: How would an ordinary rabbit act in such a pleasing manner? All this is but illusion...
aad1afe2-990a-474e-8ce4-931ab467b9f6/Opt.cn: 寻常白兔，怎会这般讨人欢心之举？此情此景，皆是虚妄……
aad1afe2-990a-474e-8ce4-931ab467b9f6/Opt.ru: Как мог бы обычный кролик вести себя таким приятным образом? Все это всего лишь иллюзия...

aad1afe2-990a-474e-8ce4-931ab467b9f6/Opt.en: With green grass covering the ground, why would you beg food of me? All this is but illusion...
aad1afe2-990a-474e-8ce4-931ab467b9f6/Opt.cn: 满地碧草，你这白兔何必向我讨食？此情此景，皆是虚妄……
aad1afe2-990a-474e-8ce4-931ab467b9f6/Opt.ru: Когда земля покрыта зеленой травой, зачем тебе выпрашивать у меня Еду? Все это всего лишь иллюзия...

aad1afe2-990a-474e-8ce4-931ab467b9f6/Opt.en: Rabbits are timid by nature. Why does this one show no fear of me? All this is but illusion...
aad1afe2-990a-474e-8ce4-931ab467b9f6/Opt.cn: 白兔胆小，为何此兔却并不惧人？此情此景，皆是虚妄……
aad1afe2-990a-474e-8ce4-931ab467b9f6/Opt.ru: Кролики пугливы по своей природе. Почему этот человек не выказывает никакого страха передо мной? Все это всего лишь иллюзия...

234e4610-6ff5-468f-a35c-368f57747ac7/Eve.en: A flicker of suspicion crosses <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s mind, and <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> hand is drawn back at once,<NL> only to see the rabbit, as if sensing those very thoughts, cast a still glance before dissolving like drifting vapor.<NL><NL> The murky air clears away, and <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s awareness grows lucid once more.<NL>Across the garden, beneath the Bodhi tree, Patriarch Bodhidharma remains as immovable as a stone, unmoving as ever...
234e4610-6ff5-468f-a35c-368f57747ac7/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>疑虑乍生，随即收回手去，<NL>便见那白兔竟似知晓了<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>心中所想一般，定定一望，霎时如云烟消散不见。<NL><NL>此地浊气尽散，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>神智重归清明，<NL>遥遥望向菩提树下，仍见达摩祖师端立如磐、分毫未动……

e85283f3-5677-4ce4-a3b4-9f5ab02ebb9b/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> advances several more steps,<NL> then halts abruptly as <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> stomach churns like storm-tossed waters, something within rampaging and crashing about,<NL>a rending pain spearing through <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> organs, as though determined to shred the bowels and tear its way out through the flesh!<NL>In that instant, the suffering becomes near unbearable, and cold sweat beads upon <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s temples...
e85283f3-5677-4ce4-a3b4-9f5ab02ebb9b/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>复行数十步，<NL>足下一顿，更觉腹内翻江倒海，似有活物在其中横冲直撞，<NL>一股撕裂般的痛感直钻脏腑，竟浑如要将<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>肠肚搅碎，生生破腹而出一般！<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>登时苦痛难当，额角冒出冷汗……

e85283f3-5677-4ce4-a3b4-9f5ab02ebb9b/Opt.en: (Could this suffering, too, be what the Shaolin monks beheld within their dreams—wrought by Mara Papiyan...?)
e85283f3-5677-4ce4-a3b4-9f5ab02ebb9b/Opt.cn: （此种痛苦，莫非也是少林僧人梦中所见，那魔王波旬所为……）
e85283f3-5677-4ce4-a3b4-9f5ab02ebb9b/Opt.ru: (Могло ли это страдание тоже быть тем, что Монахи Шаолиня видели в своих снах, вызванных Марой Папиян...?)

e5a4111a-30da-4978-8ccf-9c959ea7d332/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> recalls once more what is recorded in the scriptures—how Mara Papiyan transformed into vapor and burrowed into a monk's body,<NL>and in a sudden flash of insight, sees through it at once:<NL>this rending agony within <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> abdomen is likewise a scheme of Mara Papiyan.<NL>The fiend has taken the form of demonic Qi, entered the body to wreak havoc—seeking to disturb the mind and derail one's cultivation!
e5a4111a-30da-4978-8ccf-9c959ea7d332/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>复又忆起经中记载，魔王波旬化气钻入僧人腹中之事，<NL>心头灵光一闪，当即识破：<NL>自己腹中这般撕心裂肺之痛，原也是那波旬的诡计，<NL>此魔化为魔气，入腹作乱，便是要乱人心神、误人修行！

e5a4111a-30da-4978-8ccf-9c959ea7d332/Opt.en: (Hold the breath. Steady the mind. Resist the demonic Qi...)
e5a4111a-30da-4978-8ccf-9c959ea7d332/Opt.ru: (Задержите дыхание. Успокойте свой разум. Сопротивляйтесь Демонической ци...)

18b6bd3f-93b6-4be4-81b0-8206703141c2/Eve.en: Since <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> has seen through its treachery, how could it be allowed to wreak havoc any longer?<NL>At once, enduring the torment within, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> mind sinks into stillness, and <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> breath is steadied, True Qi summoned forth to grapple fiercely with the demonic Qi in the belly!<NL><NL>Yet when the two currents meet, it is like loong and tiger locked in combat,<NL>the pain nearly unbearable. Gritting the teeth, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> forces the issue, driving forth a surging tide of True Qi in a violent sweep.<NL>Until at last, that riotous demonic Qi is expelled entirely from <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> body!<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> snaps <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> eyes open,<NL> only to see a murky violet mass of demonic Qi hovering in midair, drifting to and fro like a headless fly, with nowhere to flee...
18b6bd3f-93b6-4be4-81b0-8206703141c2/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>洞见其奸，岂能再容它百般作乱？<NL>当即强忍腹中苦痛，沉下心来，屏息凝神，运起真气与那腹中的魔气死死相抗！<NL><NL>然则两气相遇，如龙争虎斗，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>腹痛难忍，决意咬牙一迫，只以自身沛然真气强行冲荡，<NL>终于，将那股作乱魔气尽数驱出了体外！<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>猛然睁眼，<NL>只见一团晦暗发紫的魔气徘徊半空，正如无头苍蝇般，徘徊往复，无有去处……

6b1c2167-3a11-4b2b-812b-af8b05a9ae2c/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> raises a hand and strikes with a single palm, scattering that mass of demonic Qi in one fierce blow!<NL>The malevolent presence proves powerless to resist and vanishes in the blink of an eye. In the distance, the lush shadow of the Bodhi tree comes once more into view,<NL>and only then does <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> feel lightness flow through <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> limbs, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> spirit refreshed and clear,<NL>the heart seeming a measure more lucid than before...
6b1c2167-3a11-4b2b-812b-af8b05a9ae2c/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>抬手一掌劈出，将那团魔气狠狠拍散！<NL>只见邪祟无力抵挡，眨眼消弭；远处菩提树影郁郁葱葱，又入眼帘，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>才觉通体轻快，神清气爽，<NL>心中似比先前更明净了几分……

6b1c2167-3a11-4b2b-812b-af8b05a9ae2c/Opt.en: However many schemes Mara Papiyan may contrive, I will see each of them undone...
6b1c2167-3a11-4b2b-812b-af8b05a9ae2c/Opt.cn: 波旬纵有再多计策，我自当一一破除……（继续前进……）
6b1c2167-3a11-4b2b-812b-af8b05a9ae2c/Opt.ru: Сколько бы планов ни придумала Мара Папиян, я прослежу, чтобы каждый из них был разрушен...

f8777f6e-e8b2-4658-bbed-d4b05e3ee62f/Eve.en: Thus, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> continues forward...<NL><NL>Before long, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> arrives at the edge of the lotus pool, now close enough to gaze across the water at Patriarch Bodhidharma.<NL>The pool lies still as a polished mirror, seeming boundless to the eye.<NL>Within its surface drift reflections of sky and shifting light, and among them rest pale white and verdant jade-like forms: the white are blossoms of lotus, the green their broad leaves.<NL>Several leaves align in a row, stretching from before <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> all the way to the opposite shore,<NL>like an emerald bridge floating upon the water...
f8777f6e-e8b2-4658-bbed-d4b05e3ee62f/Eve.cn: 如此，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>又继续向前行去……<NL><NL>片刻之后，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>行至莲花池畔，已足可与达摩祖师隔水相望。<NL>只见池水静如明镜，望去竟似无边无际，<NL>而镜中天光流转，万象交映，又生有白绿两色冷玉：白者乃朵朵白莲，绿者乃翠绿莲叶，<NL>其中数片莲叶连成一排，自<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>身前，一路铺向彼岸，<NL>正恍若一座浮在水面的碧色长桥……

f8777f6e-e8b2-4658-bbed-d4b05e3ee62f/Opt.en: Light as they are, the lotus leaves could serve as stepping stones for one with exceptional footwork arts...
f8777f6e-e8b2-4658-bbed-d4b05e3ee62f/Opt.cn: 莲叶虽然轻薄，若有厉害的身法，亦可以莲叶为桥……
f8777f6e-e8b2-4658-bbed-d4b05e3ee62f/Opt.ru: Какими бы легкими они ни были, листья лотоса могли бы послужить ступеньками для человека, обладающего исключительным искусством работы ногами...

e4e15256-3c28-4370-9e5a-782be4575ff9/Eve.en: Though the lotus leaves are thin,<NL>with proper footwork arts, crossing the water upon them would not be difficult.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> resolves inwardly, gathers breath, and lifts a step, intent on reaching the far bank of the lotus pool...
e4e15256-3c28-4370-9e5a-782be4575ff9/Eve.cn: 莲叶虽薄，<NL>然而倘若运转身法，踏莲过水亦非难事。<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>心中想定，便即运气提步，欲向莲花池彼岸而去……
e4e15256-3c28-4370-9e5a-782be4575ff9/Eve.ru: Хотя листья лотоса тонкие,<NL>при должном искусстве работы ногами пересечь воду на них было бы нетрудно.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> принимает внутреннее решение, набирает воздуха и делает шаг, намереваясь достичь дальнего берега бассейна с лотосами...

b93a658b-031c-48b6-bf64-8a87f0c8de79/Eve.en: Just as <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> gathers breath to move forward, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> vision darkens in an instant.<NL>The waters of the lotus pool turn suddenly dim, and a thick tide of demonic Qi surges from the far shore.<NL>In a blink, all light is swallowed, and the white lotuses wither away!<NL><NL>Raising <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> head to look across, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> beholds low-hanging storm clouds and winds poised to break.<NL>Upon the opposite bank stands an army vast as the horizon, obscuring sky and sun.<NL>At its head stands none other than Mara Papiyan himself, leading a mighty host of demons, each grotesque in form, fanged and clawed, bearing savage weapons of every kind—clearly come to strike <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> down!
b93a658b-031c-48b6-bf64-8a87f0c8de79/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>正欲提气前行，<NL>倏尔眼前一暗，便见莲花池水陡然暗沉，<NL>一股浓稠魔气自对岸汹涌而至，霎时间天光尽去，白莲尽枯！<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>抬首望向对岸，见乌云低垂，风雨欲摧，<NL>岸上千军万马，遮天蔽日，为首竟是那魔王波旬亲率庞大魔军，<NL>而魔众个个形骸可怖，尖牙利爪，手持各式凶兵，分明是为斩灭<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>而来！

df0428db-c9bd-4a69-9610-b7a554582d81/Eve.en: A shock runs through <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>,<NL>and in the next heartbeat it seems as if a host of demonic apparitions rush in from every side.<NL>Now they appear as radiant celestial beings, coaxing with honeyed words; now as snarling fiends with azure faces and jagged fangs, shouting in wrath.<NL>At times they manifest as visions of a mortal hell, bleak and terrifying; at others they mass into towering armies intent on shattering <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> to pieces!<NL><NL>The six senses and the five aggregates of <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> cannot find stillness. The legion of phantoms bears crushing force,<NL>holding <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> firmly rooted in place!
df0428db-c9bd-4a69-9610-b7a554582d81/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>猛然一惊，<NL>下一刹那，便好似有万千魔影向自己席卷而来，<NL>时而化作貌美天仙，软语劝诱；时而凝作青面獠牙，凶煞厉喝；<NL>时而又幻出人间地狱，凄厉可怖；时而又聚成如山魔军，欲将<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>摧身碎首！<NL><NL>六根五蕴，不得清净，无数魔影竟似有千钧之力，只将<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>死死按在原地！

df0428db-c9bd-4a69-9610-b7a554582d81/Opt.en: (These demonic apparitions seek to disturb my mind, but I shall not be swayed...)
df0428db-c9bd-4a69-9610-b7a554582d81/Opt.cn: （魔影欲乱我心，我自不为所动……）
df0428db-c9bd-4a69-9610-b7a554582d81/Opt.ru: (Эти демонические видения пытаются смутить мой разум, но я не поддамся влиянию...)

d73e1619-5de5-4afa-8e8c-8ec06c521a98/Eve.en: The demonic hosts gather—<NL>some unleashing storm clouds and lightning, others casting down sand and stone amid dreadful cries.<NL>But <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> gently shuts <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> eyes, body steadfast as stone, unaffected by the demons' fury.<NL>At last Mara Papiyan shouts in wrath, his voice resounding like a thunderclap across heaven and earth:<NL>"Taiwu, insolent child! Go away!<NL><NL>You aim to realize the emptiness of self and ascend to enlightment.<NL>Should you not be stopped, practitioners throughout the world would follow one after another into the realm of Buddhahood..."
d73e1619-5de5-4afa-8e8c-8ec06c521a98/Eve.cn: 是诸天鬼，<NL>或布黑云雷电，或布雨沙土石，哮吼叫呼，恶声震裂；<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>却是轻轻闭眸，身形稳如磐石，任凭周遭魔影嘶吼施压，皆不为所动。<NL>其后，波旬竟怒而大喝，声如雷霆，如贯天地，道：<NL>“太吾小儿！你且退去！<NL><NL>太吾志空我境界，使为缘觉及声闻，<NL>若不灭之令永断，世间成佛无休已……”

d73e1619-5de5-4afa-8e8c-8ec06c521a98/Opt.en: I have already broken two of your stratagems. Be it ten or a hundred more, I have nothing to fear!
d73e1619-5de5-4afa-8e8c-8ec06c521a98/Opt.cn: 方才我已破你两计，纵你还有十招百式，我亦无可畏惧！
d73e1619-5de5-4afa-8e8c-8ec06c521a98/Opt.ru: Я уже разрушил две твои уловки. Будь их еще десять или сто, мне нечего бояться!

d73e1619-5de5-4afa-8e8c-8ec06c521a98/Opt.en: If you persist in delusion and refuse to turn back, you may well fall forever into the sea of suffering, beyond all redemption...
d73e1619-5de5-4afa-8e8c-8ec06c521a98/Opt.cn: 你若执迷不悟，不肯回头，只怕终究永堕苦海，万劫不复……
d73e1619-5de5-4afa-8e8c-8ec06c521a98/Opt.ru: Если вы упорствуете в заблуждении и отказываетесь повернуть назад, вы вполне можете навсегда погрузиться в море страданий, не поддаваясь никакому искуплению...

d73e1619-5de5-4afa-8e8c-8ec06c521a98/Opt.en: I arrived here first. If you would cross these waters, you would do well to remember the order of precedence...
d73e1619-5de5-4afa-8e8c-8ec06c521a98/Opt.cn: 此地是我早到一步，尔等若欲渡水，须知晓先来后到的道理……
d73e1619-5de5-4afa-8e8c-8ec06c521a98/Opt.ru: Я прибыл сюда первым. Если вы собираетесь пересечь эти воды, вам не мешало бы запомнить порядок старшинства...

d73e1619-5de5-4afa-8e8c-8ec06c521a98/Opt.en: Heh. When you tell me to retreat, I refuse all the more. What can you possibly do to me?
d73e1619-5de5-4afa-8e8c-8ec06c521a98/Opt.cn: 嘻嘻，你叫我退，我偏不退，却不知你又能奈我何？
d73e1619-5de5-4afa-8e8c-8ec06c521a98/Opt.ru: Хех. Когда ты говоришь мне отступить, я отказываюсь еще больше. Что ты вообще можешь со мной сделать?

d73e1619-5de5-4afa-8e8c-8ec06c521a98/Opt.en: Petty demon, do you truly think a few trifling tricks can frighten me into retreat?
d73e1619-5de5-4afa-8e8c-8ec06c521a98/Opt.cn: 你这小魔，凭几招微末伎俩，竟也胆敢唬我退避？
d73e1619-5de5-4afa-8e8c-8ec06c521a98/Opt.ru: Мелкий демон, ты действительно думаешь, что несколько пустяковых трюков могут напугать меня и заставить отступить?

ab9f7874-894c-4e25-ae6f-a7663693a718/Eve.en: Unmoved and stern-faced, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> stands resolute.<NL>The terrifying visions are surely but one of Mara Papiyan's old tricks, devised to shake <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> resolve.<NL>Still, those at Shaolin never explained how such phantom legions might be dispelled.<NL>The path ahead seems wholly cut off—what is to be done now?
ab9f7874-894c-4e25-ae6f-a7663693a718/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>面色冷然，岿然不动，<NL>自知眼前魔象虽凶，却定是波旬故技重施，欲设诡计扰乱自己阵脚。<NL>只是此前少林诸人，偏未细说如何拆解这等魔军幻境，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>前路尽断，此时又当如何？

ead6da4c-6819-4dd2-be89-156c9a318c59/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s will stands firm, and fear finds no place within.<NL>Now, beholding the demonic host, they seem little more than children at play—absurd and laughable, scarcely worth notice.<NL>In time, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> simply closes <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> eyes, intent on casting aside all distraction and sinking into still reflection...<NL><NL>Gradually, the surroundings grow quiet.<NL>No demonic cries reach <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> ear, no fiendish howls stir <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> mind.<NL>Only the whisper of wind across the pond and the faint ripple of water remain,<NL>threadlike and clear to the senses.
ead6da4c-6819-4dd2-be89-156c9a318c59/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>心智甚坚，心中自然无惧，<NL>此时观诸魔军，倒像是童子戏耍一般，荒诞滑稽，不值一提。<NL>久而久之，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>索性阖上双目，意图摒除一切纷扰杂念，静心沉思……<NL> <NL>如此这般，周遭竟渐渐静了下来，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>竟而不闻魔音，不觉魔吼，<NL>唯余风过池面的轻响，及水波涟漪的微声，<NL>丝丝缕缕，清晰入耳。

ead6da4c-6819-4dd2-be89-156c9a318c59/Opt.en: (The garden remains silent—the demonic army is but an illusion!)
ead6da4c-6819-4dd2-be89-156c9a318c59/Opt.cn: （园中仍是寂静，魔军乃是幻影！）
ead6da4c-6819-4dd2-be89-156c9a318c59/Opt.ru: (Сад остается безмолвным — демоническая армия - всего лишь иллюзия!)

0993ad80-47bc-4b68-b410-e1eea508d6c0/Eve.en: A clear and resonant temple bell suddenly sounds beside the ear,<NL>like thunder dispersing chaos, washing straight through <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s very soul!<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> feels <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> body grow suddenly light, as though a wisdom-eye has opened within <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> heart.<NL>In that instant, countless mysteries become plain: those sky-filling demonic apparitions were no true forms at all, but mere bluster and illusion wrought by Mara Papiyan—<NL>before <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>, they are utterly powerless!
0993ad80-47bc-4b68-b410-e1eea508d6c0/Eve.cn: 一声清越佛钟忽自耳畔响起，<NL>如惊雷荡开混沌，直涤<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>神魂！<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>自觉肉身骤然一轻，似有慧眼自心间睁开，<NL>万千玄机，刹那明了：那漫天魔影哪是真形，分明是波旬虚张声势的幻象，<NL>于自己而言，根本不堪一击！

0993ad80-47bc-4b68-b410-e1eea508d6c0/Opt.en: (See through the illusion and charge forward!)

093a965e-1152-4163-92c7-e14ec2e59f40/Eve.en: Opening <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> eyes once more, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> gathers True Qi and leaps into the air,<NL>lightly tapping the lotus leaves to cross the water, charging straight into the demonic army without hesitation!<NL>As expected, upon drawing near there is no chill of blades, no rain of fire or thunderous strike.<NL>Instead, tens of thousands of demon apparitions wail in unison before bursting apart and scattering in an instant!<NL><NL>Turning back, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> sees that in but a blink the world has fallen utterly silent.<NL>The last trace of the Illusion army fades away, the lotus pool calm and bright beneath the sky—no sign of evil remains...
093a965e-1152-4163-92c7-e14ec2e59f40/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>再度睁眼，周身真气一提，<NL>当即飞身跃起，足尖轻点莲叶渡水而去，竟毫无迟疑地径直撞向那片魔影！<NL>果不其然，待及近时，未遇半分刀枪寒意，也无丝毫雨火惊雷，<NL>只听数万魔影齐齐哀嚎哭叫，霎时轰然散去！<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>复又回身望去，不过转眼，天地间已是万籁俱寂，<NL>魔军最后一丝幻影也悄然消散，莲池静谧，如照天光，此地再无半分邪祟踪迹……

093a965e-1152-4163-92c7-e14ec2e59f40/Opt.en: The demonic apparitions are gone. I have reached the far shore of the lotus pool... (Walk toward the Bodhi tree...)
093a965e-1152-4163-92c7-e14ec2e59f40/Opt.cn: 堪破魔影，我已至莲花池彼岸……（走向菩提树下……）
093a965e-1152-4163-92c7-e14ec2e59f40/Opt.ru: Демонические видения исчезли. Я достиг дальнего берега пруда с лотосами... (Идите к дереву Бодхи...)

1dc0baf1-b1ef-4132-803b-b01e1388a8de/Eve.en: As the balmy breeze drifts by and the scent of lotus purifies the air,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>, having endured the three perils, finally reaches the shade of the Bodhi tree.<NL>There, Patriarch Bodhidharma sits cross-legged against the ancient trunk.<NL>Yet, for reasons unknown, his form remains ethereal—half-tangible, half-phantom—as if he might dissolve into the void at any moment.<NL><NL>Without opening his eyes, Patriarch Bodhidharma senses the arrival of <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>.<NL>A faint smile brushes his lips as he speaks in a voice that seems to echo from afar:<NL>"Successor of Taiwu...<NL>"In the three thousand worlds and over billions of kalpas, even I never imagined...<NL>that within the endless cycle of Samsara, I would meet you once again."
1dc0baf1-b1ef-4132-803b-b01e1388a8de/Eve.cn: 薰风来至，莲香净时，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>历经三险，此刻终于行至菩提树下。<NL>只见达摩祖师背靠树干，盘腿而坐，然则不知何故，身形却极是朦胧，<NL>竟有几分真切，几分虚幻，唯恐须臾之后便将散去。<NL><NL>而达摩祖师双眼未睁，便已知晓<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>到来，<NL>微微一笑，悠悠说道：<NL>“太吾传人……<NL>三千世界，万亿刹那，<NL>老衲却未曾设想，这轮回之中，还能再次与你相逢……”

1dc0baf1-b1ef-4132-803b-b01e1388a8de/Opt.en: Pardon my intrusion. But is it the spirit of the Patriarch Bodhidharma himself... manifesting here before me?
1dc0baf1-b1ef-4132-803b-b01e1388a8de/Opt.cn: 不知大师，可是达摩祖师之魂灵在此显化？
1dc0baf1-b1ef-4132-803b-b01e1388a8de/Opt.ru: Простите за вторжение. Но является ли это Духом самого Патриарха Бодхидхармы... проявляющимся здесь передо мной?

43467766-ae47-4558-8a53-8e432a3f7e6b/Eve.en: Patriarch Bodhidharma speaks slowly and steadily:<NL>"Since you have traveled all this way, surely you have already understood the truth in your heart."<NL>"I am but a fleeting thought, a wisp of an illusion.<NL>It is only because of the karmic ties you carry that you are able to perceive me..."
43467766-ae47-4558-8a53-8e432a3f7e6b/Eve.cn: 达摩祖师徐徐道：<NL>“施主既然一路至此，心中想必早已明了。<NL>老衲不过一念之间，一缕幻影，<NL>施主因有宿缘在身，方才得见……”
43467766-ae47-4558-8a53-8e432a3f7e6b/Eve.ru: Патриарх Бодхидхарма говорит медленно и размеренно:<NL>"Поскольку ты проделал весь этот путь, наверняка ты уже понял истину в своем сердце".<NL>"Я всего лишь мимолетная мысль, клочок иллюзии.<NL>Только благодаря кармическим узам, которые ты несешь, ты способен воспринимать меня..."

43467766-ae47-4558-8a53-8e432a3f7e6b/Opt.en: I see... Then, if you are but an illusion, do you know the truth of this Garden of Purity?
43467766-ae47-4558-8a53-8e432a3f7e6b/Opt.cn: 原来如此……大师既为幻影，可知此处净园又是什么地方？
43467766-ae47-4558-8a53-8e432a3f7e6b/Opt.ru: Я понимаю... Тогда, если вы всего лишь иллюзия, знаете ли вы правду об этом Саду Чистоты?

c70ded8f-3456-4914-b5c7-9abceffb1ad6/Eve.en: Patriarch Bodhidharma's expression remains unmoved, his voice as leisurely as a flowing stream:<NL>"The dwelling of the five aggregates is your buddhist temple. The internal illumination of enlightenment is the gateway to the great success...<NL>This place is but a sanctuary of cultivation, reflected from within your own soul.<NL>Only one whose heart has swept away all stray thoughts—one who is pure and unstained—may tread across the lotus pool and reach the far shore..."
c70ded8f-3456-4914-b5c7-9abceffb1ad6/Eve.cn: 达摩祖师神色未动，仍是悠然道：<NL>“五蕴窟宅，是名禅院；内照开解，即大乘门……<NL>此处不过是施主心中照见，一处修行之地。<NL>唯有内心荡尽杂念、清净无染之人，方能踏过莲池，抵达彼岸……”

c70ded8f-3456-4914-b5c7-9abceffb1ad6/Opt.en: (One whose heart has swept away all stray thoughts—one who is pure and unstained...)
c70ded8f-3456-4914-b5c7-9abceffb1ad6/Opt.ru: (Тот, чье сердце отметает все посторонние мысли — тот, кто чист и незапятнан...)

3218c57b-a152-44ea-bccb-8d2715b91e51/Eve.en: Beneath the Bodhi tree, branches sway and shadows dance.<NL>A warm breeze brushes the body, bringing a profound stillness to the soul.<NL>The voice of Patriarch Bodhidharma flows slowly, as he recounts the tale of old:<NL><NL>"In ages past, many practitioners gathered here in this Garden of Purity to meditate upon the sutras, following the Buddha's teachings with devoted hearts.<NL>Yet, within their hearts, seeds of greed, flickers of anger, or the fog of delusion remained. Though they sought to sever these ties, such things are seldom cut clean in an instant.<NL>Thus, those countless stray thoughts gathered and, over time, all sank into the depths of the lotus pool.<NL>Those who attained clarity naturally severed their delusions and crossed the waters to the far shore.<NL>But those who failed to find purity were ensnared by demonic apparitions, eventually falling into the depths of the pool...<NL><NL>You must understand: Mara Papiyan is no external fiend. He is born from the desires within one's own heart—the manifestation of all inner demons.<NL>To defeat Mara Papiyan is to master one's self and sever the inner demon of one's heart."
3218c57b-a152-44ea-bccb-8d2715b91e51/Eve.cn: 菩提树下，枝摇影动，<NL>暖风拂身，心神皆宁。<NL>只听得达摩祖师语声徐缓，娓娓道来：<NL><NL>“昔年，多有修行者于净园习经打坐，遵佛祖教诲，潜心修持。<NL>然众人心间，或存贪念、或含嗔恚、或陷痴迷，纵想割舍，一时也难断得干净；<NL>如此万千杂念攒聚，日久，便尽皆沉落于那莲花池中，<NL>修得清净者，自然断却妄念，渡水而去；<NL>不得清净者，便受魔影痴缠，终堕莲池……<NL><NL>须知魔王波旬，非是外在凶魔，本是自心欲念滋生而成，乃诸般心魔之化身。<NL>欲要战胜波旬，便是要克己心、断心魔也……”

46aaf033-1da8-47b9-b672-719a25cf9e66/Eve.en: "Now that you have crossed the lotus pool today,<NL>seen through the inner demon of the heart, and utterly shattered that fiendish Mara Papiyan,<NL>from this day forth you shall be deeply rooted in Buddhist affinity, blessed with fortune, and surely safeguarded upon the path ahead..."
46aaf033-1da8-47b9-b672-719a25cf9e66/Eve.cn: “今日施主既已渡得莲花池，<NL>勘破心魔幻影，令那波旬邪祟全然溃灭，<NL>此后自是佛缘深种，福泽加身，定能护佑施主前路顺遂……”
46aaf033-1da8-47b9-b672-719a25cf9e66/Eve.ru: "Теперь, когда ты сегодня пересек бассейн с лотосами,<NL>увидел внутреннего демона сердца насквозь и совершенно разбил эту дьявольскую Мару Папиян,<NL>с этого дня вы будете глубоко укоренены в буддийской близости, благословлены удачей и, несомненно, защищены на предстоящем пути..."

46aaf033-1da8-47b9-b672-719a25cf9e66/Opt.en: When I crossed the lotus pool just now, was the Mara Papiyan I beheld real or mere illusion?
46aaf033-1da8-47b9-b672-719a25cf9e66/Opt.cn: 我方才渡莲花池时，所见的波旬究竟是真是假？
46aaf033-1da8-47b9-b672-719a25cf9e66/Opt.ru: Когда я только что пересекал бассейн с лотосами, была ли Мара Папиян, которую я видел, реальной или просто иллюзией?

6d97d6e4-d01f-4e66-b208-e6ce39eae440/Eve.en: Upon hearing these words from Patriarch Bodhidharma, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> cannot help but feel a stir of alarm within.<NL>Yet Patriarch Bodhidharma replies:<NL>"Whether it was real or false, only you yourself can know.<NL>In my view, since you have personally seen through the illusion, that illusion is naturally false..."
6d97d6e4-d01f-4e66-b208-e6ce39eae440/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>听罢达摩祖师此言，心中不免一惊，<NL>然而达摩祖师却答道：<NL>“是真是假，唯有施主自知。<NL>依老衲之见，施主既已亲自勘破幻影，那幻影，自然便是假的了……”

38d5f534-7449-400d-be3c-ca9729a63c11/Eve.en: Patriarch Bodhidharma follows with a light clap and a smile, and says:<NL>"Since you have broken the inner demon and reached the other shore, the bright mirror of your mind must now stand pure and enlightened.<NL>As I have just spoken, you have gained the highest karmic bond with the Dharma.<NL>Should you seek further refinement, accomplished forebears of the Buddha's gate will offer you measured support in your cultivation..."
38d5f534-7449-400d-be3c-ca9729a63c11/Eve.cn: 达摩祖师继而拊掌一笑，转而道：<NL>“施主既已破除心魔，踏足彼岸，想来心中明镜已是清净彻悟。<NL>如老衲方才所言，施主此番已是修得无上佛缘，<NL>若欲精进修为，自有佛门得道先辈，为施主修行稍作护持……”

12698923-273d-4d9a-b631-ea5dc36df466/Eve.en: "Amitabha...<NL>If you should come into possession of a token of the Arhat,<NL>then in days to come, when you cultivate your martial arts and seek a breakthrough, you shall receive the Arhat's unseen protection and gain aid beyond sight..."
12698923-273d-4d9a-b631-ea5dc36df466/Eve.cn: “阿弥陀佛……<NL>施主若得罗汉信物在手，<NL>日后修行功法，欲求突破之际，自能蒙罗汉暗中护持，得助于无形……”
12698923-273d-4d9a-b631-ea5dc36df466/Eve.ru: "Амитабха...<NL>Если ты вступишь во владение знаком Архата,<NL>тогда в грядущие дни, когда ты будешь совершенствовать свои Боевые искусства и стремиться к Прорыву, ты получишь незримую защиту Архата и помощь за пределами видимости..."

78132f8c-4f48-4352-b6fa-aca6ff66ab8a/Eve.en: At this point, Bodhidharma sighed peacefully,<NL>"You have been blessed with such a rare opportunity.<NL>If you dedicate yourself to cultivation, in time, you might surpass the ancients and reach heights never achieved before..."<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> can now use the power of the Arhat's token to perform Martial Arts Breakthrough.<NL>The effects vary depending on the chosen statue...)</color>
78132f8c-4f48-4352-b6fa-aca6ff66ab8a/Eve.cn: 说至此处，达摩祖师安然叹道：<NL>“施主既有此等殊胜机缘，若能潜心修行，<NL>假以时日，未必不能超越往古，臻至前人未及之境……”<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>已可借罗汉信物之力突破功法，<NL>依据所择佛像不同，所得突破效果亦各不相同……）</color>

b664c90e-2d3e-4e53-a1e7-330207c57361/Eve.en: Patriarch Bodhidharma says nothing. He silently extends a hand.<NL>A moment later, a single Bodhi leaf loosens from its branch and drifts lightly down into his palm.<NL>Only then does he join his hands with a faint smile and speak slowly:<NL>"The bonds of this world pass through countless kalpas, abiding ever within birth and death—how could mortal words exhaust their telling?<NL>I am neither the self of yesterday nor the self of tomorrow. Yet for the grace you bear toward me, I must still offer my thanks..."
b664c90e-2d3e-4e53-a1e7-330207c57361/Eve.cn: 达摩祖师不语，默然伸手，<NL>须臾，便有一片菩提叶离了枝头，飘飘悠悠，落于其掌心之中。<NL>随后，达摩祖师方才含笑合掌，缓缓道：<NL>“世间因缘，经百千劫，常在生死，又岂是人言所能尽述？<NL>老衲虽非昨日旧身，亦非来日新我，然而施主之情分，老衲却仍要谢过……”

708c47f4-8e5c-43be-b340-06ad5215727b/Eve.en: His words are layered in mystery—laden with hidden meaning, yet maddeningly unspecific.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> cannot grasp them at once. As <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> focus gathers in contemplation, in no more than the span of a blink,<NL>Patriarch Bodhidharma's figure dissolves like morning mist into the empty air, nowhere to be found...
708c47f4-8e5c-43be-b340-06ad5215727b/Eve.cn: 此语万般玄奥，似藏深意，却又当真语焉不详。<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>一时捉摸不透，正凝神思索时，未料不过眨眼的刹那，<NL>达摩祖师的身影便如晨雾散入虚空，再也无处可寻……

657cd876-46d9-42fd-a649-d4b9c72b8841/Eve.en: All at once, the world turns black.<NL>As <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> regains clarity, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> realizes that <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> has never left the Bodhidharma Cave.<NL>The surroundings are shadowed and moist, and ahead stands only a plain rock face—neither Bodhi trees nor those weathered doors in sight...
657cd876-46d9-42fd-a649-d4b9c72b8841/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>继而又觉天地一黑，<NL>猛然回神时，才惊觉自己竟仍然身处达摩洞内，<NL>四下昏黑，幽暗潮湿，眼前不过一处寻常石壁，既无菩提树园，亦无古朴大门……

657cd876-46d9-42fd-a649-d4b9c72b8841/Opt.en: (Was what I saw just now real or an illusion...?)
657cd876-46d9-42fd-a649-d4b9c72b8841/Opt.ru: (Было ли то, что я только что видел, реальностью или иллюзией...?)

fa2a355a-fb59-45db-9654-932509aa0337/Eve.en: Unease stirs within <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>. As <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> gaze shifts,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> suddenly sees a figure standing at <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/>—it is Wuzi, who ought already to have entered Shaolin!<NL>Yet whatever he has undergone, he now appears thoroughly disheveled,<NL>his monk's robe badly creased, dust still clinging to his face...
fa2a355a-fb59-45db-9654-932509aa0337/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>心下惊疑，目光流转间，<NL>又见身旁赫然站着一人，正是理应已经拜入少林寺中的无字！<NL>然而，不知他此前历经何事，此刻模样格外狼狈，<NL>身上僧袍褶皱不堪，面上似还沾着尘土……

0cedb6bd-d955-488e-8dee-5fa320559936/Eve.en: Wuzi still seems shaken, lingering fear plain upon his face.<NL>He first bows deeply to <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>, then recounts the matter in detail:<NL>"Upon first entering Shaolin, I lost my way and strayed here by mistake.<NL>I never expected that within such a narrow cavern, so many demonic apparitions would lurk. They are able to summon wind and rain, call down thunder and fire.<NL>When they descended, their fury was as though an army of thousands bore down upon me! My cultivation is shallow, so I could not withstand them.<NL>Had you not intervened just now, I truly believed my life would end here..."
0cedb6bd-d955-488e-8dee-5fa320559936/Eve.cn: 无字好似惊魂未定，面上犹有后怕，<NL>此时先是对<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>深深一拜，方才将前因细细说来：<NL>“小僧初入少林，原是迷了路，才误入此地。<NL>却不料这洞窟狭小，竟有诸多魔影深藏其中，能呼风唤雨，引雷招火，<NL>袭来时更是声势骇人，堪比千军万马！小僧修为尚浅，实在难以抗衡，<NL>方才若非施主出手相救，小僧真真是以为，要殒命在此了……”

099ce4ea-e6b1-4e43-a00a-19e6bec2afde/Eve.en: A deep unease settles within <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>. Looking about once more,<NL>the many demonic apparitions in the Bodhidharma Cave appear restored to their former state.<NL>Yet upon closer scrutiny, far more of them have manifested than before—some brandishing talons, others baring fangs,<NL>more grotesque and dreadful than any previously seen—the very phantoms encountered in the Garden of Purity by the lotus pool!
099ce4ea-e6b1-4e43-a00a-19e6bec2afde/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>深觉诡异，再看四周，<NL>达摩洞中原本诸多魔影，眼下已然恢复如初，<NL>可细瞧之下，比之从前，竟又凭空多出许多，或持利爪、或露獠牙，<NL>比往日所见的魔影更显狰狞可怖，正是自己于那净园之中、莲池之畔，曾经见过的魔影！

099ce4ea-e6b1-4e43-a00a-19e6bec2afde/Opt.en: Were these the demonic apparitions that attacked you just now?
099ce4ea-e6b1-4e43-a00a-19e6bec2afde/Opt.cn: 方才袭击你的可是这些魔影？
099ce4ea-e6b1-4e43-a00a-19e6bec2afde/Opt.ru: Были ли это те демонические видения, которые только что напали на вас?

01230962-3434-4191-996d-a8c2e4af113e/Eve.en: Wuzi nods at once, lingering fear still upon his face, and says:<NL>"Indeed... For reasons unknown, once you intervened,<NL>the demonic apparitions reined in their malice. They did not strike again, only pacing back and forth within the cave.<NL>This magentus gold alms bowl was obtained before I entered Shaolin. I owe you my life—and the guidance you once bestowed.<NL>I have nothing with which to repay such grace. Please accept this, so I may find peace..."<NL><NL>Having spoken such, Wuzi draws an object from his robes,<NL>cradling it with utmost care as he presents it before <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>...
01230962-3434-4191-996d-a8c2e4af113e/Eve.cn: 无字和尚立时颔首，心有余悸道：<NL>“正是如此……不知何故，施主出手之后，<NL>这些魔影便收敛了戾气，未曾再次袭来，只在这洞中往复徘徊罢了。<NL>此紫金钵盂，乃是小僧拜入少林寺前所得，小僧受施主救命之恩，与昔日点拨之恩，<NL>实在无以为报，还请施主收下此物，小僧方才心安……”<NL><NL>无字说罢，自怀中取出一物，<NL>好似万般珍重，捧至<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>眼前……

a978fca3-3db2-4faf-ad47-cf7ceb4630d8/Eve.en: In Wuzi's upturned hands rests a Magentus Gold Bowl.<NL>Though weathered by many years, its surface remains smooth and whole, suffused with a quiet spiritual radiance.<NL>Hearing his words, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> falls into brief reflection, then declines to refuse again and places the bowl within <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> pack.<NL><NL>When <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> looks to Wuzi once more, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> finds the monk smiling gently, utterly at ease—an expression that feels strangely familiar...
a978fca3-3db2-4faf-ad47-cf7ceb4630d8/Eve.cn: 只见无字双手所捧，乃是一紫金钵盂，<NL>虽已久经年岁，周身却圆润完满，自有一股灵光佛气；<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>听得无字此言，心中若有所思，便未再推拒，将此物收入行囊。<NL><NL>再次望向无字时，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>瞧他眉眼含笑，神情自若，这般神态，竟又觉得分外眼熟……

7b428f64-d4d6-42aa-99f0-115e6ae26a7c/Eve.en: Wuzi pauses at the question, then answers:<NL>"I am but an ordinary man of the mundane world.<NL>By heaven's mercy, I was born with a trace of Buddha-nature. Since I first knew my own mind, I have devoted myself wholly to the Dharma, without distraction.<NL>In hopes of receiving proper instruction and cultivating in earnest at Shaolin, I journeyed a thousand li to reach this place,<NL>seeking only to enter the mountain gate and follow the teachings of the Buddha..."
7b428f64-d4d6-42aa-99f0-115e6ae26a7c/Eve.cn: 无字闻言一愣，仍是答道：<NL>“小僧不过是个凡俗之间，一个寻常之人，<NL>蒙上天垂怜，生来便携几分佛性，自懂事起便一心向佛，再无旁骛。<NL>为求在少林得受正规教化、潜心修行，小僧才不远千里而来，<NL>只求能入山门，追随佛祖教诲……”

7b428f64-d4d6-42aa-99f0-115e6ae26a7c/Opt.en: How could an ordinary monk evoke such a sense of familiarity within me...?
7b428f64-d4d6-42aa-99f0-115e6ae26a7c/Opt.cn: 寻常小僧，怎会令我有这般熟稔之感……
7b428f64-d4d6-42aa-99f0-115e6ae26a7c/Opt.ru: Как мог обычный Монах вызвать во мне такое знакомое чувство?..

d89098f7-f092-4978-8485-5bc72ba9df2f/Eve.en: Yet Wuzi says:<NL>"An odd coincidence, indeed.<NL>Since the day we parted at the small shrine, I have often thought of you.<NL>Your face has always seemed familiar to me, as though we had met somewhere before.<NL>But when I reflect upon it, I only just arrived in this land, with no past ties. There is no reason we should have known one another.<NL>So I wonder in secret: could it be that we once met within a dream?<NL><NL>Forgive my boldness, but I cannot shake the feeling that, at some unknown time, we once spoke idly beneath a Bodhi tree.<NL>The memory is faint and hazy—like something from another lifetime..."
d89098f7-f092-4978-8485-5bc72ba9df2f/Eve.cn: 无字却道：<NL>“说来也巧。<NL>自那日小庙一别，小僧便常常思及施主之事，<NL>只觉施主面容似曾相识，仿佛在哪处见过一般。<NL>可转念一想，小僧初到这片地界，未有旧时，断无曾与施主相识的道理，<NL>便暗自思忖：莫不是曾在梦中与施主相逢？<NL><NL>不怕施主见笑，小僧总觉得不知何时，曾与施主在菩提树下有一番闲话，<NL>此感依稀朦胧，竟恍如隔世一般……”

d89098f7-f092-4978-8485-5bc72ba9df2f/Opt.en: (Met within a dream and spoke idly beneath the tree...?)
d89098f7-f092-4978-8485-5bc72ba9df2f/Opt.ru: (Встретились во сне и лениво поговорили под деревом...?)

4e972a50-99a3-47b2-8e92-9b602f36602e/Eve.cn: 此信最末，高僧写道：<NL>无字曾言，与<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>缘法未尽，<NL>待得来日，若是自己修行有成，足以独当一面之时，<NL>或将拜别少林寺而去，去往天下世间，云游四海，<NL>终有一日，或许云游至太吾村中，能寻<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>一叙，也未可知……

c460bab5-5195-4bb9-8ed5-68686b2c2d34/Eve.en: With the letter read through, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> sets it aside.<NL>It seems this chapter has reached its end, though the ties of the workings of fate in this world are always beyond easy reckoning.<NL>If destiny still holds a thread between them, then someday, they are certain to cross paths once more...
c460bab5-5195-4bb9-8ed5-68686b2c2d34/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>阅看完毕，收起此信。<NL>心道此事总算了结，此世间因缘际会，向来玄妙，<NL>若当真还有未尽缘法，有朝一日，定能再与无字重逢……

3d79705b-1245-4a8a-a45c-b2a8d5b2f02d/Eve.en: "To be without thought is to be without mind. To be without mind is to be without form.<NL>To be without form is innate authenticity. And that authenticity is the Tao...<NL><NL>Should confusion linger in your heart, tarry here and converse on the principles of Chan.<NL>Though my cultivation is modest, I might be able to ease one or two of your doubts..."
3d79705b-1245-4a8a-a45c-b2a8d5b2f02d/Eve.cn: “无念即无心，无心即无物，<NL>无物即天真，天真即大道……<NL><NL>倘若施主心怀迷津，不妨与小僧闲坐片刻，共论禅机，<NL>凭小僧浅薄修为，或能为施主解忧一二……”

dd5b5243-a396-4095-adb5-40031f9999fd/Eve.en: "All arising and perishing within the Three Realms, all existence and emptiness among the myriad dharmas, are governed by the single mind.<NL>If a thought stirs, one enters the Three Realms. If that thought falls still, one leaves them...<NL><NL>Your connection to the Buddha's path is most deep—what unresolved confusion yet lies upon your road of cultivation?"
dd5b5243-a396-4095-adb5-40031f9999fd/Eve.cn: “三界生灭，万法有无，皆由一心。<NL>一念心生，即入三界；一念心灭，即出三界……<NL><NL>施主佛缘已是至深，不知当下修行之路，有何未解之惑？”

ba710aea-594b-4ecd-a8ca-9bf1143cb674/Eve.en: "All beings possess Buddha-nature within,<NL>this seed of wisdom like the sun, radiant and complete, vast and boundless,<NL>yet obscured by the heavy clouds of the five aggregates... thus beings cannot see it.<NL><NL>I will attempt to dispel your confusion with shallow words—please listen with focus..."<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(Hearing this answer to Capacity confusion will, on the next martial arts breakthrough,</color><NL><color=#lightgrey>increase <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s Capacity Cap once...)</color>
ba710aea-594b-4ecd-a8ca-9bf1143cb674/Eve.cn: “众生身中，皆有佛性，<NL>此慧根犹如日轮，体明圆满，广大无边，<NL>只因五阴重云覆障，众生方才不见……<NL><NL>小僧愿为施主略破迷障，粗浅之言，还请施主凝神静听……”<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（听取无字解答天资之惑，在下一次进行功法突破时，</color><NL><color=#lightgrey>能够提升一次<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>的天资上限……）</color>

85adfaf7-8b0b-4db0-8168-75a80f135cdf/Eve.en: After this, Wordless gently closed his eyes,<NL>slowly explaining doubts, clarifying causes,<NL>discussing countless Zen principles and methods, stating that ignorance and wisdom are no different, and that all dharmas are thus.<NL>The words felt ethereal and dreamlike—like glimpsing enlightenment itself, neither real nor unreal, neither identical nor different...<NL><NL>After some time, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> suddenly felt clarity in the heart,<NL>all previous confusion now dispelled like clouds parting to reveal the sun...<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s Capacity Cap has increased...)</color><NL><color=#lightgrey>(Before the next martial arts breakthrough, repeating this will not increase it again...)</color>
85adfaf7-8b0b-4db0-8168-75a80f135cdf/Eve.cn: 此后，无字双目微合，<NL>缓声剖解疑难，细说缘由，<NL>又论及千种禅机，万般法门，更道无明智慧等无异，当知万法即皆如。<NL>诸般言辞一时缥缈玄乎，恍惚之中，似见佛果，非实非虚，非如非异……<NL><NL>如此半晌而后，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>竟觉心头豁然开朗，<NL>先前诸多混沌之处，此刻已然拨云见日，无不心领神会……<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>的天资上限得到了提升……）</color><NL><color=#lightgrey>（在进行下一次功法突破前，纵然再次听取无字解惑，天资上限亦不会再次提升……）</color>

e510172f-a1a7-4907-a947-c8c048513d7e/Eve.en: "If one can fully perceive the true mind, and the source is pure,<NL>then all wishes are fulfilled, all actions complete, all is accomplished, and there is no further rebirth...<NL><NL>I will attempt to dispel your confusion with shallow words—please listen with focus..."<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(Hearing this answer to Breakthrough confusion will, on the next martial arts breakthrough,</color><NL><color=#lightgrey>increase <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s Breakthrough Success Rate once...)</color>
e510172f-a1a7-4907-a947-c8c048513d7e/Eve.cn: “若能彻见本心，心源清净，<NL>一切愿足，一切行满，一切皆办，不受后有……<NL><NL>小僧愿为施主略破迷障，粗浅之言，还请施主凝神静听……”<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（听取无字解答突破之惑，在下一次进行功法突破时，</color><NL><color=#lightgrey>能够提升一次<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>的突破成功率……）</color>

4035cd26-99da-4d06-9415-0eb6581b73d0/Eve.en: "In transmitting the Dharma, the Buddha was aided by disciples who attained realization and bore the fruit of attainment—these are known as the Eighteen Arhats.<NL>To ensure the Dharma endures in later ages, the Eighteen Arhats abide in the world, refraining from nirvana,<NL>traveling through many lands to propagate the teaching and bring benefit to sentient beings.<NL>Each Arhat, dwelling in the world, possesses distinct spiritual powers.<NL>Their sculpted statues likewise reflect their respective methods of the path.<NL><NL>Since you have cultivated supreme affinity with the Buddha, when you seek breakthrough in your martial arts,<NL>if you contemplate before an Arhat Statue, you may receive the unseen protection of that Arhat's powers..."
4035cd26-99da-4d06-9415-0eb6581b73d0/Eve.cn: “佛法传度，有佛祖得道弟子相佐，得至果位，乃称十八罗汉，<NL>为使佛法流传后世，十八罗汉永住世间，不入涅槃，<NL>游学各地，弘扬佛法，利益众生。<NL>众罗汉立世，自是各具神通，<NL>以其貌所塑之像，亦有法门相照，<NL><NL>施主既已修得无上佛缘，若于功法突破之际，<NL>取罗汉像用以参悟，自可得像之中罗汉神通护持……”

bca3e033-54de-4f69-88ac-5d8b6f3490a0/Eve.en: Wuzi continues:<NL>"I had resolved to remain in this small shrine for a few days of quiet cultivation,<NL>to let the scattered thoughts of my heart subside before setting out for Shaolin on Mt. Song.<NL>Yet after hearing your words, the worries that weighed upon me have parted like clouds before the sun, vanishing without trace,<NL>and my mind stands suddenly clear..."
bca3e033-54de-4f69-88ac-5d8b6f3490a0/Eve.cn: 无字又道：<NL>“小僧原本打定主意，索性在这小庙中静修几日，<NL>待心中杂念尽去，再动身前往嵩山少林寺。<NL>如今听了施主一番话语，先前的烦忧竟像拨云见日一般，尽数烟消云散，<NL>令小僧豁然开朗……”

bca3e033-54de-4f69-88ac-5d8b6f3490a0/Opt.en: It was merely a casual word of mine—have you already understood it so completely?
bca3e033-54de-4f69-88ac-5d8b6f3490a0/Opt.cn: 我不过随口一言，你竟已这般快地领悟通透么？
bca3e033-54de-4f69-88ac-5d8b6f3490a0/Opt.ru: Это было просто мое случайное слово — неужели вы уже так хорошо его поняли?
